detail.title: Low Barriers, High Stakes: Formal and Informal Diffusion of AI in the Workplace

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.26-001
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is diffusing rapidly in the workplace, yet aggregate productivity gains remain limited. This paper examines the dual diffusion of AIthrough both formal, employer-led and informal, employee-initiated adoption-as potential explanation. Using a representative survey of nearly 10,000 employees in Germany, we document a high extensive but low intensive margin of usage: while 64 percent use AI tools, only 20 percent use them frequently. This diffusion is strongly skill-biased and depends less on establishment and regional characteristics. While formality is associated with more frequent usage, training, AI-based supervision, and higher perceived productivity gains, it does not broaden access. These patterns suggest that widespread informal usage can coexist with limited productivity effects when complementary investments and organizational integration lag behind.

AI.tldr: AI在工作场所快速扩散但总体生产力提升有限，本文通过研究雇主主导的正式采用和员工自发的非正式采用的双重扩散模式来解释这一现象。研究发现AI使用广度大但深度小，扩散具有技能偏向性，正式采用虽能提高使用频率和感知生产力，但未能扩大使用范围。
AI.research_question: 为什么AI在工作场所快速扩散但总体生产力提升有限？雇主主导的正式采用和员工自发的非正式采用如何影响AI的扩散模式和使用效果？
AI.motivation: AI在工作场所迅速普及，但宏观层面的生产力增长仍然有限，这种"生产力悖论"需要解释。现有研究多关注正式采用，忽略了员工自发的非正式采用，需要从双重扩散角度理解AI的实际使用模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术扩散理论、组织采用理论、技能偏向型技术变革理论、互补性投资理论
AI.method: 使用德国近10,000名员工的代表性调查数据，分析AI使用的广度和深度，比较正式和非正式采用的差异，考察技能、机构特征和地区因素的影响。
AI.findings: 1. AI使用广度大但深度小：64%员工使用AI工具，但只有20%频繁使用；2. 扩散具有强烈技能偏向性，受机构和地区特征影响较小；3. 正式采用与更频繁使用、更多培训、AI监督和更高感知生产力相关，但未能扩大使用范围；4. 非正式使用普遍存在但生产力效应有限，因为互补性投资和组织整合滞后。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AI扩散的双重模式理论（正式vs非正式）；2. 扩展了技术扩散理论，强调组织整合和互补性投资的重要性；3. 为"生产力悖论"提供了微观机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为管理者提供AI采用策略建议：需要平衡正式和非正式采用；2. 强调培训和组织整合的重要性；3. 指出单纯扩大使用范围不足以提升生产力，需要深度整合和互补性投资。

detail.abstract: This study explores the relationship between ethical practices in digital marketing and their impact on consumer trust and brand perception within the Albanian market. Employing a combination of quantitative and qualitative methodologies, the research examines how various business types, and the presence of digital marketing departments influence ethical standards. The findings reveal a significant positive correlation between high ethical standards and increased consumer trust. Additionally, the results highlight industry-specific variations in the implementation of ethical practices, suggesting that the type of business significantly affects how ethics are perceived and integrated. The study also investigates the potential moderating role of digital marketing capabilities in ethical implementations. While findings on this aspect were marginally significant, they indicate an emerging trend that merits further exploration. Based on these insights, the paper provides recommendations for businesses on enhancing ethical practices in digital marketing and suggests areas for future research to deepen understanding of these dynamics. Recommendations are made for businesses to develop industry-specific ethical guidelines and enhance transparency in digital operations. Policymakers are advised to strengthen regulations to support ethical practices, fostering a trustworthy digital market environment. Keywords: Digital Marketing, Brand Perception, Consumer Trust, Business Ethics, Albania

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了阿尔巴尼亚市场中数字营销伦理实践与消费者信任及品牌感知之间的关系。研究发现高伦理标准与消费者信任呈显著正相关，且伦理实践的实施存在行业差异。数字营销能力在伦理实施中的调节作用虽边际显著但值得进一步探索。
AI.research_question: 数字营销伦理实践如何影响阿尔巴尼亚市场的消费者信任和品牌感知？不同企业类型和数字营销部门的存在如何影响伦理标准的实施？数字营销能力是否在伦理实施中起调节作用？
AI.motivation: 随着数字营销在阿尔巴尼亚市场的快速发展，伦理实践对消费者信任和品牌感知的影响日益重要。然而，该领域在阿尔巴尼亚市场的研究相对缺乏，特别是关于不同企业类型和数字营销能力如何影响伦理实践的实施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于商业伦理理论、消费者信任理论和品牌感知理论。结合数字营销伦理框架，探讨伦理实践如何通过影响消费者信任进而塑造品牌感知。
AI.method: 采用混合研究方法，结合定量和定性方法。定量部分可能包括问卷调查和数据分析，定性部分可能包括访谈或案例研究，以深入理解不同企业类型和数字营销部门对伦理实践的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 高伦理标准与消费者信任呈显著正相关；2. 伦理实践的实施存在行业特异性差异，企业类型显著影响伦理的感知和整合方式；3. 数字营销能力在伦理实施中的调节作用边际显著，表明这一趋势值得进一步探索。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了数字营销伦理理论在阿尔巴尼亚市场的应用；2. 揭示了企业类型对伦理实践实施的影响机制；3. 初步探索了数字营销能力作为调节变量的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业提供增强数字营销伦理实践的具体建议；2. 建议制定行业特定的伦理指南；3. 建议提高数字运营透明度；4. 为政策制定者提供加强监管以支持伦理实践的建议，促进可信的数字市场环境。

detail.abstract: Export performance has become crucial for Vietnamese manufacturing SMEs as they face digital transformation and stronger global competition. This study investigates how resource-based determinants affect the export performance of Vietnamese manufacturing SMEs, with absorptive capacity (mediation) and international competition (moderation). Cross-sectional survey data from 420 manufacturing SMEs in Vietnam were collected during February–August 2025 and completed by authorized firm representatives (owners/directors/senior managers). Partial least squares structural equation modeling (SmartPLS 4.1) with 5,000 bootstraps was employed. Digital transformation (β = 0.304, p < 0.01), logistics infrastructure (β = 0.289, p < 0.01), and human capital (β = 0.284, p < 0.001) are the strongest predictors; marketing capability (β =0.124, p < 0.01) and access to finance (β = 0.108, p < 0.01) are positive. Absorptive capacity positively affects exports (β = 0.161, p < 0.01) and mediates four determinants (the most significant for human capital, indirect β = 0.046, p < 0.01). International competition strengthens the effect of human capital (β = 0.115, p < 0.01) but weakens marketing capability (β = –0.102, p < 0.01). The model explains 57.3% of the variance in export performance. These findings highlight the need for policies promoting digital adoption, logistics upgrades, and human-capital development, while firms should enhance learning capabilities and recalibrate marketing strategies under increasing competitive pressure.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨越南制造业中小企业的资源基础决定因素如何影响出口绩效，以吸收能力为中介变量，国际竞争为调节变量。研究发现数字化转型、物流基础设施和人力资本是最强预测因子，吸收能力起中介作用，国际竞争对人力资本有正向调节但对营销能力有负向调节。
AI.research_question: 资源基础决定因素如何影响越南制造业中小企业的出口绩效？吸收能力和国际竞争在这一关系中起什么作用？
AI.motivation: 越南制造业中小企业在数字化转型和全球竞争加剧的背景下，出口绩效变得至关重要。需要了解哪些资源基础因素影响其出口表现，以及吸收能力和国际竞争如何调节这些关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源基础观（Resource-Based View），吸收能力理论，国际竞争理论
AI.method: 横断面调查设计，从越南420家制造业中小企业收集数据（2025年2-8月），使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（SmartPLS 4.1）和5000次自举法
AI.findings: 数字化转型（β=0.304）、物流基础设施（β=0.289）和人力资本（β=0.284）是最强预测因子；营销能力（β=0.124）和融资渠道（β=0.108）有正向影响。吸收能力对出口有正向影响（β=0.161）并中介四个决定因素（人力资本的中介效应最强，间接β=0.046）。国际竞争强化人力资本的影响（β=0.115）但弱化营销能力的影响（β=-0.102）。模型解释出口绩效57.3%的方差。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了资源基础观在中小企业出口绩效中的应用，验证了吸收能力的中介作用和国际竞争的调节作用，为新兴市场中小企业国际化理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供促进数字化转型、物流升级和人力资本发展的依据；为企业建议增强学习能力，在竞争压力下调整营销策略

title: It Only Takes OneBite: Viral Reviews in the Attention Economy
affiliations: University of Toronto - Department of Economics

detail.title: It Only Takes OneBite: Viral Reviews in the Attention Economy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract: In this era of information abundance, firms must compete for scarce consumer attention. Exploiting a unique quasi-experimental setting, I investigate how viral attention from a OneBite pizza video review impacts firm performance. After a OneBite review is posted to YouTube, total spending and total customers immediately increase at the reviewed pizzeria. The increase, however, critically depends on the review score. While scores < 7.0/10.0 do not affect firm performance and scores in the range [7.0,8.0) generate modest improvements, review scores ≥ 8.0 increase spending by over 47% and increase customers by over 52% in each of the first two months following the review. Despite the immediate increases, the effects are transitory, and all metrics revert to pretreatment levels within four months of the review. The trend reversion indicates that while revealed quality initially increases firm performance, viral attention fades, and more recent reviews divert consumers towards newly reviewed pizzerias; attention governs consumer choice. Rather than business-stealing, I determine that market expansion drives growth, as firm performance at nearby competitors remains constant.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用OneBite披萨视频评论的准实验设置，发现病毒式关注对餐厅业绩有显著但短暂的影响。评分≥8.0的评论在发布后前两个月内使消费额增加47%以上、顾客数增加52%以上，但效果在四个月内完全消退。增长主要来自市场扩张而非业务抢夺。
AI.research_question: 病毒式关注（通过OneBite披萨视频评论）如何影响餐厅的业绩表现？这种影响是否持久？增长机制是市场扩张还是业务抢夺？
AI.motivation: 在信息过载时代，消费者注意力成为稀缺资源。企业需要了解病毒式关注如何影响业绩，特别是这种影响是否持久，以及增长背后的机制是什么。
AI.theoretical_framework: 注意力经济学、消费者选择理论、口碑营销、质量信号理论、市场扩张与竞争效应
AI.method: 利用OneBite披萨视频评论在YouTube上发布的准实验设置，分析评论发布前后餐厅业绩数据，包括总消费额和顾客数量。采用断点回归设计，比较不同评分区间（<7.0、[7.0,8.0)、≥8.0）的影响差异，并追踪时间动态效应。
AI.findings: 1. 评论评分≥8.0时效果最显著：前两个月消费额增加47%以上，顾客数增加52%以上；2. 评分<7.0无显著影响；3. 评分[7.0,8.0)有适度改善；4. 所有效果在四个月内完全消退；5. 增长来自市场扩张而非业务抢夺（竞争对手业绩保持不变）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了病毒式关注的短期效应和衰减动态；2. 揭示了注意力在消费者选择中的核心作用；3. 区分了市场扩张与业务抢夺机制；4. 为注意力经济学提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 企业应关注高质量内容创造以获得病毒式关注；2. 管理者需认识到病毒效应的短暂性，制定持续营销策略；3. 平台可优化推荐算法以延长关注持续时间；4. 创业者可利用病毒效应快速获取初始客户。

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study underscores the importance of aligning marketing strategies with consumer psychology during disasters. By adopting ethical, informed, and responsive approaches, businesses can navigate crises effectively while safeguarding consumer trust and organizational sustainability. Future research should explore longitudinal impacts of disasters on consumer behaviour and the effectiveness of different marketing interventions across diverse contexts.

Volume 25
Issue - 25 December 2025
pp. 1-9

detail.abstract: Disasters such as pandemics, natural hazards and economic crises significantly disrupt normal consumption patterns and challenge business operations. This systematic literature review examines consumer behavior during disasters and the marketing strategies adopted by business organizations, with particular emphasis on psychological factors that drive behavioral change. Drawing on prior studies, this review identifies common consumer behavior patterns including panic buying, stockpiling, reduced brand loyalty, and shifts towards essential goods. Psychological drivers such as fear, uncertainty, perceived scarcity, social influence and the need for control play a central role in shaping these behaviors. In response, organizations adopt adaptive marketing strategies such as pricing adjustments, transparent communication, ethical promotions and supply chain reconfiguration to ensure availability and maintain consumer trust. Using a systematic review methodology, this study synthesizes findings from international literature and Sri Lankan based research to develop a comprehensive understanding of disaster induced consumption dynamics. The review further proposes a conceptual framework illustrating the relationship between disasters, psychological factors, consumer behavior and organizational marketing strategies. By integrating insights from prior empirical and conceptual studies, this paper contributes to disaster related consumer research and provides practical implications for managers to design responsible and resilient marketing strategies during crisis situations.

AI.tldr: 这篇系统文献综述研究了灾害期间消费者行为模式（如恐慌性购买、囤积、品牌忠诚度降低）及其心理驱动因素（恐惧、不确定性、感知稀缺性），并分析了企业为应对这些变化而采取的适应性营销策略。
AI.research_question: 灾害如何影响消费者行为？企业应采取何种营销策略来应对灾害期间的消费动态变化？
AI.motivation: 灾害（如疫情、自然灾害、经济危机）会显著扰乱正常消费模式并挑战企业运营，需要系统理解灾害期间的消费者行为和企业应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于心理学理论，特别是恐惧、不确定性、感知稀缺性、社会影响和控制需求等心理因素驱动行为改变的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述方法，综合国际文献和斯里兰卡本土研究的发现，构建概念框架。
AI.findings: 识别了恐慌性购买、囤积、品牌忠诚度降低、转向必需品等常见消费者行为模式；心理驱动因素包括恐惧、不确定性、感知稀缺性、社会影响和控制需求；企业采取价格调整、透明沟通、道德促销和供应链重构等适应性策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个概念框架，阐明灾害、心理因素、消费者行为和组织营销策略之间的关系；整合了先前实证和概念研究的见解，为灾害相关消费者研究做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者设计负责任和有韧性的危机营销策略提供实践启示，帮助企业确保产品供应和维持消费者信任。

detail.abstract: The increased number of ethnic media in Assam, especially the Vernacular Television channels, has opened opportunities for different brands to communicate with ethnic consumers directly. This proposition led to a new advertising dilemma for the brands. Whether to target ethnic audiences with the pan India advertisements, dub the ethnic language, or create a new commercial targeting the audience? The majority have just dubbed their pan-India advertisements in the vernacular language. Only regional brands are using ethnic spokespersons and ethnic symbols in their advertisements. The present study primarily describes the level of ethnic advertising practices in the vernacular TV channels in Assam. It aims at assessing the level of ethnic advertising across the product categories, the status of spokespersons and brand categories. Moreover, the study also put lights on the satisfaction level of audiences with the ethnic advertising practices.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了阿萨姆邦方言电视频道中的民族广告实践水平，评估了不同产品类别、代言人和品牌类别的民族广告现状，并调查了观众对这些广告实践的满意度。
AI.research_question: 阿萨姆邦方言电视频道中民族广告实践的水平如何？不同产品类别、代言人和品牌类别在民族广告方面有何差异？观众对这些民族广告实践的满意度如何？
AI.motivation: 阿萨姆邦民族媒体（特别是方言电视频道）数量增加，为品牌直接与民族消费者沟通创造了机会。这给品牌带来了新的广告困境：是使用泛印度广告针对民族受众、将广告配音成民族语言，还是创建针对该受众的新广告？大多数品牌只是将泛印度广告配音成方言语言，只有区域品牌在广告中使用民族代言人和民族符号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民族广告理论、跨文化传播理论、消费者行为理论、品牌定位理论
AI.method: 描述性研究，通过内容分析评估阿萨姆邦方言电视频道中的广告实践，可能包括广告内容分析、品牌分类、代言人分析以及观众满意度调查
AI.findings: 1. 大多数品牌只是将泛印度广告配音成方言语言；2. 只有区域品牌在广告中使用民族代言人和民族符号；3. 不同产品类别在民族广告实践上存在差异；4. 观众对当前的民族广告实践可能有不同的满意度水平
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了民族广告理论在印度多语言文化背景下的应用；2. 提供了方言媒体环境中广告策略的实证证据；3. 揭示了品牌在民族市场定位中的差异化策略
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为品牌在阿萨姆邦等多元文化地区的广告策略提供指导；2. 帮助品牌更好地理解民族消费者的需求和偏好；3. 为媒体策划和广告创意提供实践建议；4. 促进更有效的跨文化沟通和品牌本土化策略

title: Data as a Contested Economic Resource

detail.title: Data as a Contested Economic Resource
detail.abstract: Data is often said to be the most valuable commodity of our age. It is a curiosity, therefore, that it remains largely invisible on the balance sheets of companies, in our national economic accounts, and in international commercial statistics. Yet, exploited by ever more powerful machine-learning engines that extract previously unattainable information that can be monetized in myriad ways, data is reshaping the economy (including by training artificial intelligence (AI) systems), underpins the market valuation of today's most valuable corporations, and has incentivized an historic build-out of supporting infrastructure (including data centres and dedicated electricity generation). At the same time, the negative externalities generated by the unregulated and undisciplined use of data is driving worldwide moves to establish guardrails for its use. Overlaid on the economics of data are the manifold consequences of its exploitation, including through ever more powerful artificial intelligence systems, in reshaping society, politics, and geopolitics. There is no good historical analogue for data as an essential capital asset and thus there is no good historical analogue for a regulatory framework to distribute the benefits and to control the negative externalities to which it gives rise. This has made data and the economic returns it generates one of the principal bones of contention in today's economy.

AI.tldr: 数据作为关键资本资产在会计、经济统计中不可见，但通过机器学习/AI系统重塑经济、支撑企业估值，同时产生负外部性，缺乏历史监管框架，成为经济争议焦点。
AI.research_question: 数据作为核心资本资产，为何在会计和经济统计中不可见？如何建立适当的监管框架来分配其收益并控制负外部性？
AI.motivation: 数据被称为当今最有价值的商品，却在资产负债表、国民经济账户和国际商业统计中几乎不可见，这种矛盾需要解释。同时，数据通过AI/ML系统重塑经济、支撑企业估值，但产生负外部性，缺乏历史监管框架，成为经济争议焦点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产理论、外部性理论、数据经济学、无形资产会计、监管框架理论、数字经济理论
AI.method: 概念分析、理论构建、案例研究（基于数据驱动型企业的市场估值、数据中心基础设施投资、AI系统发展等现实现象）
AI.findings: 1. 数据作为关键资本资产在传统会计和经济统计体系中不可见；2. 数据通过机器学习/AI系统产生巨大经济价值，重塑经济结构；3. 数据使用产生显著负外部性；4. 缺乏历史监管框架导致收益分配和外部性控制问题；5. 数据成为当代经济主要争议点
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出数据作为新型资本资产的理论框架；2. 分析数据在传统经济统计中的不可见性问题；3. 构建数据外部性和监管框架的理论基础；4. 为数字经济理论提供新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供数据监管框架设计参考；2. 为企业数据资产管理和会计处理提供指导；3. 为投资者评估数据驱动型企业提供分析框架；4. 为国际数据治理和贸易谈判提供理论支持

title: Structural Fiscalistics as First Philosophy for AI-Mediated Institutions

detail.title: Structural Fiscalistics as First Philosophy for AI-Mediated Institutions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived as influencing this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a theoretical and methodological study. It does not involve human participants, personal data, or empirical experimentation, and therefore does not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper proposes Structural Fiscalistics as a first-philosophy charter for AI-mediated institutions. The central risk in such environments is not simply error, but ontological substitution: fluent outputs can be misrecognized as institutional facts when admissibility and representation are weak. To stabilize institutional reality against this drift, the paper formalizes an irreversible pipeline—Evidence → Structure → Readout—and argues that institutional systems must be able to refuse (exclude) inputs before they interpret them.

The framework is anchored in a two-axis fiscal grammar that functions as a condition of possibility for institutional objecthood: X tracks cross-jurisdictional fiscal shift, and Y tracks downward, irreversible intergenerational post-tax capacity. On this plane, institutional tension is treated not as malfunction but as a necessary condition of institutional existence—what makes constraint visible, comparable, and auditable rather than narratively smooth.

Two instruments operationalize the charter. Fiscal Epistemology (FE) specifies admissibility conditions (provenance, traceability, replayability) that determine what may count as institutionally real. Fiscal Geometry (FG) renders admitted evidence into stable, machine-legible structural objects, keeping representation upstream of interpretation. The paper concludes with a charter statement positioning Structural Fiscalistics as a domain-agnostic governance substrate for high-risk decision systems (tax, compliance, finance, education), where institutional truth must remain rooted in auditable structure rather than generated coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"结构性财政主义"作为AI中介机构的第一哲学宪章，核心风险是"本体替代"而非简单错误。通过"证据→结构→读取"不可逆流程和财政语法(X轴跨司法财政转移，Y轴代际税后能力)，将制度张力视为制度存在的必要条件而非故障。财政认识论和财政几何学作为操作工具，确保制度真实性基于可审计结构而非生成一致性。
AI.research_question: 在AI中介的制度环境中，如何防止"本体替代"风险并稳定制度现实？如何构建一个能够拒绝输入而非仅解释输入的治理框架？
AI.motivation: AI中介的制度环境中存在"本体替代"风险——流畅输出可能被误认为制度事实，当可采性和表征薄弱时。需要防止制度现实漂移，确保高风险决策系统(税务、合规、金融、教育)的制度真实性基于可审计结构而非生成一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性财政主义作为第一哲学宪章；本体替代理论；制度现实稳定理论；两轴财政语法(X轴跨司法财政转移，Y轴代际税后能力)；制度张力作为制度存在必要条件；证据→结构→读取不可逆流程。
AI.method: 概念框架构建；形式化不可逆流程(证据→结构→读取)；财政语法两轴分析；财政认识论(规定可采性条件：来源、可追溯性、可重放性)；财政几何学(将证据转化为稳定、机器可读的结构对象)。
AI.findings: 制度系统必须在解释输入前能够拒绝(排除)输入；制度张力是制度存在的必要条件而非故障；通过财政认识论和财政几何学可操作化宪章；结构性财政主义可作为领域无关的治理基底。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"结构性财政主义"作为AI中介制度的第一哲学宪章；形式化"本体替代"风险概念；发展两轴财政语法作为制度对象性的可能性条件；重新概念化制度张力为制度存在的必要条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高风险决策系统(税务、合规、金融、教育)提供领域无关的治理基底；操作工具：财政认识论(规定可采性条件)和财政几何学(稳定结构表示)；确保制度真实性基于可审计结构而非生成一致性。

title: Product Design and Market Size in Innovative Industries
affiliations: University of Murcia, Faculty of Business and Economics, Department of Economic Analysis and Universitat de València

detail.title: Product Design and Market Size in Innovative Industries
detail.abstract: In a model of spatial product differentiation, we analyze the role of product design in industries with quality competition among creators of new products. In contrast with the extant literature, the predictions from our analysis help explain relevant facts in important innovative industries. In particular, those predictions fit with the fall in the estimates for the elasticity of new products entry with respect to market size, reported in the empirical literature dealing with the pharmaceutical industry. Based on this central result, our analysis is also consistent with other aspects of the empirical evidence in that industry, like the observed fall in both product quality and per capita welfare indicators.

AI.tldr: 本文在空间产品差异化模型中分析质量竞争行业中产品设计的作用，解释了医药行业新产品进入对市场规模弹性下降的现象，并与产品质量和人均福利指标下降的实证证据一致。
AI.research_question: 在质量竞争行业中，产品设计如何影响新产品进入对市场规模的弹性？特别是在医药行业，为什么新产品进入对市场规模的弹性会下降？
AI.motivation: 现有文献无法解释重要创新行业（如医药行业）中新产品进入对市场规模弹性下降的实证现象，需要新的理论框架来解释这一现象及其相关特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间产品差异化模型，结合质量竞争理论，分析产品设计在创新行业中的作用机制。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建空间产品差异化模型，推导产品设计在质量竞争环境下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 模型预测解释了医药行业新产品进入对市场规模弹性下降的现象，并一致性地解释了产品质量和人均福利指标下降的实证证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了空间产品差异化理论，将产品设计纳入质量竞争分析框架，为解释创新行业的实证规律提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为医药行业政策制定者提供了理论依据，帮助理解行业创新动态，为监管决策提供参考。

title: The Fourfold Action Framework A Quadimensional Model of Entrepreneurial Progression and Effective Foundership
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Fourfold Action Framework A Quadimensional Model of Entrepreneurial Progression and Effective Foundership

declarations.funderStatement: Funded through personal resources.

detail.abstract: Entrepreneurship research has traditionally emphasized discrete drivers of success such as operational execution, strategic planning, psychological resilience, or purpose-driven leadership. While each of these domains has been independently validated, existing literature lacks an integrative, action-based framework that explains how founders progress sustainably through stages of entrepreneurial development. This paper introduces the Fourfold Action Framework, which posits that founder effectiveness emerges from the integration of four interdependent domains of action: pragmatic, strategic, energetic, and spiritual. Drawing from entrepreneurship studies, organizational psychology, leadership theory, and meaning-making research, the paper argues that entrepreneurial stagnation and burnout frequently result not from insufficient effort, but from action imbalance-over-reliance on one domain at the expense of others. The framework is further positioned as a mechanism of progression across staged models of entrepreneurial development, including the McKenzie Success Hierarchy (McKenzie, 2025), while remaining theoretically independent. Implications for entrepreneurial education, founder development, and leadership research are discussed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个四重行动框架，认为创始人效能源于实用、战略、能量和精神四个相互依存行动领域的整合，解释了创始人如何可持续地通过创业发展阶段，避免因行动失衡导致的停滞和倦怠。
AI.research_question: 创始人如何通过整合四个相互依存的行动领域（实用、战略、能量、精神）来可持续地推进创业发展阶段，避免因行动失衡导致的停滞和倦怠？
AI.motivation: 传统创业研究强调离散的成功驱动因素（如运营执行、战略规划、心理韧性或目标驱动领导力），但缺乏一个整合的、基于行动的框架来解释创始人如何可持续地通过创业发展阶段。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四重行动框架（实用、战略、能量、精神行动领域），整合了创业研究、组织心理学、领导力理论和意义建构研究，并与McKenzie成功层次模型等阶段性创业发展模型相联系。
AI.method: 概念性框架开发，基于现有文献的理论整合，提出一个解释性框架，并与其他阶段性创业发展模型建立联系。
AI.findings: 创始人效能源于四个行动领域的整合；创业停滞和倦怠通常不是由于努力不足，而是由于行动失衡（过度依赖某一领域而忽视其他）；该框架可作为推进创业发展阶段的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合的、基于行动的理论框架，解释了创始人如何可持续地通过创业发展阶段；将离散的成功驱动因素整合为一个相互依存的系统；为创业发展理论提供了新的视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业教育和创始人发展提供指导框架；帮助创始人识别和纠正行动失衡；为领导力研究和实践提供新的工具；有助于预防创业倦怠和促进可持续发展。

title: A Strategic-Relational Approach to European Union Enlargement: The Reversed Conditionality of Western Balkan Governing Elites
affiliations: University of Peloponnese - Dept. of Political Science & International Relations and University of Peloponnese - Dept. of Political Science & International Relations

detail.title: A Strategic-Relational Approach to European Union Enlargement: The Reversed Conditionality of Western Balkan Governing Elites

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the European Union under Grant 101085582 – EU-FP-WB (ERASMUS-JMO-2022-HEI-TCH-RSCH). The views and opinions expressed are those of the authors only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Education and Culture Executive Agency (EACEA). Neither the European Union or the EACEA can be held responsible for them.

detail.abstract: The article applies Jessop's and Hay's strategic-relational approach to the European Union's enlargement policy. Focusing on the leaders of applicant countries, the authors argue that these are reflexive actors, who may break the confines of the structurally determined compliance/non-compliance binary choice in European Union (EU) accession negotiations and explore additional policy options. In the Western Balkans, governing elites have repeatedly attempted to make the European Union dilute its accession conditions by presenting the EU institutions with their preferred policy dilemmas. The authors term this practice "reversed conditionality". The article examines two cases of reversed conditionality: Serbia's alliance with Russia and the threat of unification of Albania and Kosovo. With these case studies, the authors provide a comparative assessment of the effects of such practice for both its initiators and the EU's enlargement policy.

AI.tldr: 本文运用战略关系方法分析欧盟扩大政策，提出"反向条件性"概念，指申请国精英通过制造政策困境迫使欧盟淡化入盟条件，并以塞尔维亚-俄罗斯联盟及阿尔巴尼亚-科索沃统一威胁为案例进行研究。
AI.research_question: 申请国领导人如何突破欧盟入盟谈判中结构性决定的合规/不合规二元选择，探索额外政策选项？"反向条件性"实践对申请国和欧盟扩大政策产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 传统欧盟扩大研究多关注欧盟如何通过条件性影响申请国，忽视了申请国作为反思性行动者主动塑造谈判进程的能力。本文旨在填补这一研究空白，揭示申请国精英如何策略性地影响欧盟政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: Jessop和Hay的战略关系方法，强调行动者在结构约束下的反思性和策略性行动能力，突破结构决定论。
AI.method: 比较案例研究法，分析两个"反向条件性"案例：塞尔维亚与俄罗斯的联盟关系，以及阿尔巴尼亚与科索沃统一的威胁。
AI.findings: 西巴尔干地区统治精英通过向欧盟机构呈现其偏好的政策困境，多次试图迫使欧盟淡化入盟条件。这种"反向条件性"实践表明申请国领导人并非被动接受者，而是能够主动塑造谈判议程的反思性行动者。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将战略关系方法应用于欧盟扩大政策研究；2) 提出"反向条件性"概念，挑战传统条件性研究的单向视角；3) 强调申请国精英的反思性和策略性行动能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为欧盟政策制定者理解申请国策略行为提供分析框架；2) 帮助申请国精英更有效地设计谈判策略；3) 为欧盟扩大政策的实践调整提供参考。

title: Humanitarian Response and the Coordination Dilemma: Navigating Efficacy, Earnings, and Ethics
affiliations: Arizona State University

detail.title: Humanitarian Response and the Coordination Dilemma: Navigating Efficacy, Earnings, and Ethics
detail.abstract: In this chapter, I discuss the drivers and obstacles of coordination in humanitarian response based on three interconnected dimensions-efficacy, earning, and ethics. Next, I provide a high-level synthesis of game-theoretic models commonly used to analyze coordination mechanisms, highlighting their insights and limitations in humanitarian contexts. My key critiques include insufficient attention to response agencies' different-and sometimes opposing-value systems, the assumption of unidimensional payoffs, and abstract modeling. While coordination is often assumed to be universally beneficial, this chapter cautions against this view and advocates for more realistic, adaptive approaches that reflect the complex realities of field operations. This includes more empirically grounded, context-sensitive mechanisms and strategic pre-disaster agreements that enable trust and operational alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人道主义响应中协调的驱动因素与障碍，基于效能、收益和伦理三个维度，批判现有博弈论模型的局限性，主张更现实、适应性的协调方法。
AI.research_question: 人道主义响应中的协调机制面临哪些驱动因素和障碍？如何设计更有效的协调方法以应对复杂的实地操作现实？
AI.motivation: 现有协调机制研究常假设协调总是有益的，但忽视了人道主义机构间不同的价值体系、多维度的回报以及实地操作的复杂性，需要更现实的协调方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于效能、收益和伦理三个相互关联的维度分析协调机制；运用博弈论模型分析协调机制，但批判其局限性。
AI.method: 理论分析框架：基于三个维度（效能、收益、伦理）的分析；对现有博弈论模型进行高层次综合评述；批判性分析现有模型的局限性。
AI.findings: 协调并非总是有益的；现有博弈论模型存在三大局限：忽视机构间不同甚至对立的价值体系、假设单维回报、过度抽象建模；需要更现实、适应性的协调方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出基于效能、收益和伦理的三维分析框架；批判现有博弈论模型在人道主义背景下的局限性；挑战"协调总是有益"的普遍假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 主张更实证基础、情境敏感的协调机制；建议建立灾前战略协议以促进信任和操作协调；提倡反映实地操作复杂性的适应性协调方法。

title: Anwar Balance Test (ABT) Legal Doctrine of Systemic Accountability

detail.title: Anwar Balance Test (ABT) Legal Doctrine of Systemic Accountability

detail.abstract: The Anwar Balance Test (ABT) advances justice by measuring whether decisions align with Light, Gray, or Shadow. This community supports research, tools, and case studies that improve legal clarity, reduce bias, and strengthen institutional integrity.

AI.tldr: ABT通过衡量决策与光、灰、影的对齐程度来推进司法公正，社区支持研究、工具和案例研究以提升法律清晰度、减少偏见和加强制度完整性
AI.research_question: Anwar平衡测试如何通过衡量决策与光、灰、影的对齐程度来推进司法公正？

detail.abstract:
This treatise presents the African Federation Treaty Framework (AFTF) v3.1, a definitive institutional blueprint designed to operationalise socio-economic sovereignty and political unity across the African continent. Developed by Africa’s Sovereign Development Trust® (ASDT) under the leadership of David Okiki Amayo Jr., the AFTF provides a rigorous solution to the historical fragmentation and systemic developmental paradoxes that have traditionally impeded African progress.
The framework establishes a Tripartite System of governance, finance, and defence, anchored by four primary pillars:

1. The African Sovereign Development Finance Fund (ASDF): A sovereign capital engine for generational infrastructure.

2. OmniGaza®: A sovereign-grade blockchain substrate ensuring algorithmic fidelity, transparency, and real-time settlement for continental transactions.

3. The United African Defence Force (UADF): A unified military and intelligence structure guaranteeing regional stability.

4. The African Rare Earth Mineral Fund (AREMF): A mechanism for sovereign resource control and continental value retention.

Transitioning from a conceptual agreement to a formal Jurisprudential Treatise, Version 3.1 mandates the absolute supremacy of Federation law. Key institutional modules introduced in this iteration include:

• Digital & Cognitive Sovereignty (Art. 8): Codifies immunity against external computational and ideological threats through Lattice-Based Cryptography (Quantum Shielding) and native Synthetic Intelligence, securing African decision-making processes.
• Commercial & Logistical Anchors (Art. 9): Designates the Northlands (Nairobi) and Mai Mahiu (UADF HQ) as primary bonded warehouses and trade facilitation hubs, integrated via the OmniGaza algorithmic ledger.
• Phased Governance Strata (Art. 10.6): Implements a tiered institutional onboarding system—Silver, Gold, and Platinum—allowing for precise fiduciary management of partners. This scales participation from observer status to full institutional sovereignty via the Master Sovereign Investment Agreement (MSIA).
• Jurisdictional Finality (Art. 11-13): Establishes the Federation Court as the supreme judicial authority. The "Supremacy Override" ensures that national statutes remain subservient to Federation mandates, solidifying the transition from a non-extractive Trust to a permanent Constitutional Federation.

By architecting a hardened institutional interior, the AFTF v3.1 provides the legal and technological substrate for Africa to engage the global order as a unified, peer-level superpower.

title: Open or Closed: Charging Network Openness, Pricing, and Social Welfare
affiliations: , Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information & Systems Management, HKU Business School, The University of Hong Kong and Nanjing Audit University

detail.title: Open or Closed: Charging Network Openness, Pricing, and Social Welfare
detail.abstract: The rapid electrification of the automotive industry is transforming competition by integrating charging infrastructure with vehicle sales, thereby creating a servitized market environment. In practice, manufacturers adopt three distinct infrastructure strategies: non-opening, where networks remain proprietary; asymmetric opening, where access is unidirectional; and bilateral opening, where networks are mutually shared. We develop a game-theoretic model to examine the economic impact of these strategies, focusing on how they reshape the dimensions of competition. Specifically, non-opening drives dual competition on price and service; bilateral opening homogenizes service quality, leaving only price competition; and asymmetric opening introduces a hybrid structure where firms compete with heterogeneous service capabilities. We analyze these strategies in a setting where manufacturers simultaneously determine vehicle prices and the quantity of charging stations. Our findings reveal that interoperability costs and charging convenience jointly shape equilibrium strategies. While low and high costs dictate mutual opening and non-opening, respectively, the intermediate cost regime is dynamic. Here, asymmetric opening is sustainable only under moderate convenience; low convenience drives a shift toward mutual opening (driven by efficiency), while high convenience compels a return to non-opening (driven by differentiation). Our analysis also highlights a misalignment between private incentives and social welfare. While manufacturers maximize profits under bilateral opening when the interoperability cost is low, this strategy is never socially optimal. Instead, social welfare is maximized under asymmetric opening or non-opening scenarios. Finally, we identify conditions where private and social incentives align, providing a rationale for asymmetric opening as a welfare-enhancing strategy. These findings offer implications for policymakers regulating infrastructure access to achieve a winwin outcome.

AI.tldr: 本文研究汽车制造商在电动车充电基础设施方面的三种策略（不开放、不对称开放、双边开放）如何影响竞争格局。研究发现互操作性成本和充电便利性共同决定均衡策略，且私人激励与社会福利存在错配，不对称开放在某些条件下能实现福利提升。
AI.research_question: 汽车制造商在电动车充电基础设施方面采用的不同开放策略（不开放、不对称开放、双边开放）如何影响市场竞争格局和经济效率？
AI.motivation: 汽车行业快速电气化正在通过将充电基础设施与车辆销售整合来改变竞争格局，创造了服务化的市场环境。实践中制造商采用不同的基础设施策略，需要理解这些策略的经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，分析三种基础设施策略：非开放（专有网络）、不对称开放（单向访问）、双边开放（相互共享）。关注互操作性成本和充电便利性对竞争维度的影响。
AI.method: 开发博弈论模型，制造商同时确定车辆价格和充电站数量，分析三种基础设施策略下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1) 互操作性成本和充电便利性共同决定均衡策略：低成本导致双边开放，高成本导致非开放，中间成本区域动态变化。2) 不对称开放仅在中等便利性下可持续。3) 私人激励与社会福利存在错配：制造商在低成本时偏好双边开放，但社会最优策略是不对称开放或非开放。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立了分析电动车充电基础设施开放策略的博弈论框架。2) 揭示了互操作性成本和便利性如何共同决定策略均衡。3) 识别了私人激励与社会福利的错配机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为制造商选择基础设施策略提供决策依据。2) 为政策制定者监管基础设施访问提供理论支持，以实现双赢结果。3) 识别了不对称开放作为福利提升策略的条件。

detail.abstract: This textbook on Corporate Governance is both timely and invaluable. It offers essential insights to readers and learners seeking a comprehensive understanding of the contemporary developments that shape the design and implementation of governance systems across corporate entities worldwide. By addressing the key issues that direct and control organizational objectives, missions, visions, and core values, the text remains relevant to both advanced and emerging economies. The book presents, with clarity and depth, the nature and scope of corporate governance, its conceptual and theoretical frameworks, and the empirical evidence that underpins modern governance practices. It further explores the roles and significance of strategic, tactical, and operational managers, highlighting their relationships, alliances, and contributions to effective corporate leadership. A wide range of professionals-including administrators, managers, auditors, anti-graft and economic-crime practitioners, boards of directors or trustees, management consultants, researchers, educators, and officers within central and local governments-will find this textbook particularly useful and instructive.

title: When Creative Is Cheap but Attention Is Not: Budgeted Creative Testing Policies for Generative AI-Assisted Marketing Content
affiliations: University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business

detail.title: When Creative Is Cheap but Attention Is Not: Budgeted Creative Testing Policies for Generative AI-Assisted Marketing Content
detail.abstract: Generative tools make marketing creatives easy to produce, but customer attention for testing remains scarce. In many channels, teams follow a shortlist workflow: generate several candidate messages, spend a limited test budget to learn, and then roll out a single winner to the remaining impressions. We propose SMART-Roll (Scarce-attention Marketing Adaptive Rollout with Test-and-Roll), a budgeted creative-testing policy that reallocates impressions within a fixed test budget via batched elimination (Successive Halving; SH), with a conservative Safe-SH variant for downside-risk regimes. Using 7,654 Upworthy headline experiments (Matias et al. 2021) and two pre-specified reward models (plug-in and Beta-Binomial), we find that at budgets scaled to a fraction of each story's observed impressions, batched elimination increases clicks relative to uniform test-and-roll (UTR (Feit and Berman 2019)) by 0.60% under plug-in (about 770 extra clicks per 10 million impressions) and 0.66% under Beta-Binomial. Because many organizations operationalize generative creative through shortlists (human-or tool-generated), our confirmatory evidence focuses on matched-budget allocation within finite shortlists. We evaluate the interpretability layer separately through out-of-time stability and drift diagnostics. The gains are heterogeneous, motivating a validated deployment map and a Safe-SH fallback in identified high-risk regimes. Finally, SMART-Roll includes a low-dimensional interpretability layer that produces lever cards-structured summaries of how candidate sets differ along recurring message dimensions-and monitoring diagnostics (transfer, drift, and stability checks) to support governance (post-hoc explainability, drift monitoring, and constraint auditing), even when predictive transfer of the learned representation is limited in this archive.

AI.tldr: SMART-Roll是一种针对稀缺注意力营销的创意测试策略，通过分批淘汰机制在固定测试预算内重新分配曝光，相比传统均匀测试方法能提升点击率0.6-0.66%，并提供可解释性层支持治理。
AI.research_question: 如何在客户注意力稀缺的情况下，通过有限的测试预算优化营销创意的选择和推广策略？
AI.motivation: 生成式工具使营销创意制作变得容易，但用于测试的客户注意力仍然稀缺。许多团队采用候选名单工作流程：生成多个候选消息，用有限的测试预算学习，然后将单个获胜者推广到剩余曝光中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于稀缺注意力营销、分批淘汰（Successive Halving）理论、测试与推广（Test-and-Roll）框架，以及Beta-Binomial奖励模型。
AI.method: 提出SMART-Roll策略，在固定测试预算内通过分批淘汰重新分配曝光，包含保守的Safe-SH变体用于下行风险场景。使用7,654个Upworthy标题实验和两种预设奖励模型（插件和Beta-Binomial）进行验证。
AI.findings: 在按每个故事观察曝光比例缩放的预算下，分批淘汰相比均匀测试与推广（UTR）能提升点击率：插件模型下0.60%（每1000万曝光约770次额外点击），Beta-Binomial模型下0.66%。收益具有异质性，需要验证的部署地图和Safe-SH回退机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出SMART-Roll框架，将分批淘汰应用于营销创意测试；2）开发Safe-SH变体处理下行风险场景；3）建立低维可解释性层，提供杠杆卡片和监控诊断；4）验证了在有限候选名单中的预算分配效果。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为组织提供可操作的创意测试策略，提升营销效果；2）提供治理支持工具（事后可解释性、漂移监控、约束审计）；3）识别高风险场景并提供安全回退机制；4）支持生成式创意工具的实际应用工作流程。

title: Sustainable Economic Impact of The Congo River: Lessons For Regional Development and Resource Management

detail.title: Sustainable Economic Impact of The Congo River: Lessons For Regional Development and Resource Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is to declare that this paper is my own research conception and creativity that has not been yet published.However , with the support of two co-authors it has been finalized and published.

declarations.funderStatement: With much acknowledgements this research study was funded by both Durban University of Technology.

detail.abstract: The Congo River, a vital resource for millions of people and diverse wildlife, faces increasing pressure due to fluctuating rainfall patterns, resulting in water scarcity. Additionally, inadequate transboundary water management further exacerbates these challenges, highlighting the need for coordinated and sustainable governance strategies. This study investigates the current state of water management and the role of youth education in protecting the Congo River Basin's freshwater resources, which spans multiple nations. The research aims to understand how environmental awareness and youth involvement can help mitigate water scarcity issues and promote sustainable practices in the region. The study employs a qualitative approach, including surveys and interviews with both schoolchildren and adults, to assess their knowledge of the Congo River's significance and the impact of poor water management on local and regional economies. The results reveal a significant gap in the knowledge of both adults and children regarding the importance of safeguarding the river, despite its critical role in transportation, agriculture, and local livelihoods. Many participants are unaware of the river's potential to flood, dry up, or become contaminated, highlighting the need for better education and awareness programs. Additionally, the study finds that the Congo River's economic potential, especially in maritime transport, is hindered by underdeveloped infrastructure and poor management, which limits its role in alleviating water and energy scarcity in the region. The findings suggest that empowering youth through education on environmental conservation, particularly water management, is key to ensuring sustainable practices for future generations. In conclusion, increased awareness and investment in infrastructure are essential to unlock the Congo River's full potential as a critical economic and environmental resource for global economic advancement.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨刚果河流域水资源管理现状及青年教育在保护淡水资源中的作用，发现公众对河流重要性认知不足，建议通过教育提升环保意识并加强基础设施建设。

AI.theoretical_framework: 环境教育理论、青年参与理论、可持续水资源管理理论、跨境水资源治理理论。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，包括对学童和成人的调查和访谈，评估他们对刚果河重要性的认知以及不良水资源管理对当地和区域经济的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 成人和儿童对保护河流重要性的认知存在显著差距；2. 许多参与者不了解河流可能发生的洪水、干涸或污染风险；3. 刚果河的经济潜力（特别是海上运输）因基础设施不发达和管理不善而受限；4. 青年教育是确保未来可持续实践的关键。

AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议加强青年环保教育项目；2. 呼吁改善刚果河流域的基础设施建设；3. 提出需要提升公众对河流重要性的认知；4. 为政策制定者提供跨境水资源管理的实践指导。

title: Enterprise Innovation in Developing Countries: An Evidence from Ethiopia
affiliations: Western Michigan University - Department of Economics, , Haramaya University and University of Pécs - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Enterprise Innovation in Developing Countries: An Evidence from Ethiopia
detail.abstract: Enterprise innovation has gained the interest of development policymakers and scholars as the bases for the industrial development. This study comprehensively analyzes the drivers of enterprise innovation in developing countries. The study uses survey data to analyze the determinants of enterprise innovation in Ethiopia using a multivariate probit (MVP) model. For this study, enterprises were grouped into four categories: all-sized, large-sized, medium-sized, and micro-and small-sized enterprises. It appears that engagement in R & D, on-the-job training, and website ownership significantly determine enterprise innovation. This study, unlike previous studies, comprehensively analyzes drivers of innovation by considering enterprises in different sizes and all at the same time. This helps identify factors most relevant for enterprise innovation at all stage which help policymakers get focused on strategy development. Based on the findings, further emphasis on engagement in R & D would help enterprises to become innovative for all categories of enterprises. Furthermore, strengthening the available formal training and diversifying type of the training that is related to skills, knowledge, and techniques that help achieve the long-term objective of the enterprises are worth considering. Enterprises also need to subscribe to different sites that help learn more and access information.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用多元概率模型分析埃塞俄比亚企业创新的驱动因素，发现研发投入、在职培训和网站所有权对企业创新有显著影响，研究考虑了不同规模企业（大型、中型、小微）的差异。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家企业创新的驱动因素是什么？特别是埃塞俄比亚不同规模企业的创新决定因素有哪些？
AI.motivation: 企业创新是产业发展的基础，对发展中国家的政策制定者和学者具有重要意义。现有研究缺乏对不同规模企业创新驱动因素的综合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业创新理论，特别是资源基础观和创新系统理论，研究企业规模与创新活动的关系。
AI.method: 使用调查数据，采用多元概率模型分析埃塞俄比亚企业的创新决定因素，将企业分为四类：全规模、大型、中型、小微。
AI.findings: 研发投入、在职培训和网站所有权对企业创新有显著正向影响。这些因素在不同规模企业中都具有重要性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了发展中国家企业创新驱动因素的实证证据，扩展了企业规模与创新关系的理论理解，填补了现有研究对不同规模企业创新因素综合分析的空缺。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供有针对性的策略建议：加强研发投入、改进正式培训体系、鼓励企业建立网站获取信息。这些建议适用于不同规模的企业发展阶段。

title: Modelling Energy Consumption, Carbon Dioxide Emissions and Economic Growth Nexus in Ethiopia: Evidence from Cointegration and Causality Analysis
affiliations: University of Pécs - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: Modelling Energy Consumption, Carbon Dioxide Emissions and Economic Growth Nexus in Ethiopia: Evidence from Cointegration and Causality Analysis
detail.abstract: Policy makers need to know the relationship among energy use, economic growth and environmental quality in order to formulate rigorous policy for economic growth and environmental sustainability. This study analyzes the nexus among energy consumption, affluence, financial development, trade openness, urbanization, population and CO2 emissions in Ethiopia using data from 1970-2014. The ARDL cointegration results show that cointegration exists among the variables. Energy consumption, population, trade openness and economic growth have positive impact on CO2 in the long-run while economic growth squared reduces CO2 emissions which confirms that the EKC hypothesis holds in Ethiopia. In the short-run urbanization and energy consumption intensify environmental degradation. Toda-Yamamoto granger causality results indicate the bi-directional causality between energy consumption and CO2 emissions, CO2 emissions and urbanization. Financial development, population and urbanization cause economic growth while economic growth causes CO2 emissions. Causality runs from energy consumption to financial development, urbanization and population which in turn cause economic growth. From the result, CO2 emissions extenuation policy in Ethiopia should focus on environmentally friendly growth, enhancing consumption of cleaner energy, incorporating the impact of population, urbanization, trade and financial development.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用1970-2014年数据分析了埃塞俄比亚能源消费、富裕程度、金融发展、贸易开放度、城市化、人口与CO2排放之间的关系。研究发现存在协整关系，长期内能源消费、人口、贸易开放和经济增长对CO2有正向影响，而经济增长平方项减少CO2排放，支持EKC假说。短期内城市化和能源消费加剧环境退化。因果检验显示能源消费与CO2排放、CO2排放与城市化之间存在双向因果关系。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚能源消费、经济增长、金融发展、贸易开放、城市化、人口与CO2排放之间存在怎样的关系？这些变量之间是否存在长期均衡关系和因果关系？
AI.motivation: 政策制定者需要了解能源使用、经济增长和环境质量之间的关系，以便制定促进经济增长和环境可持续性的严格政策。埃塞俄比亚作为发展中国家，需要平衡经济发展与环境保护。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境库兹涅茨曲线(EKC)假说，探讨经济增长与环境质量之间的倒U型关系；能源-经济增长-环境(EGC)三元关系理论；协整理论和格兰杰因果关系分析。
AI.method: 使用ARDL(自回归分布滞后)协整方法检验变量间的长期均衡关系；采用Toda-Yamamoto格兰杰因果关系检验分析变量间的因果关系；数据覆盖1970-2014年。
AI.findings: 1. 变量间存在协整关系；2. 长期内能源消费、人口、贸易开放和经济增长对CO2排放有正向影响；3. 经济增长平方项减少CO2排放，支持EKC假说；4. 短期内城市化和能源消费加剧环境退化；5. 能源消费与CO2排放、CO2排放与城市化之间存在双向因果关系；6. 金融发展、人口和城市化导致经济增长，而经济增长导致CO2排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了EKC假说在埃塞俄比亚的适用性；2. 扩展了能源-经济增长-环境三元关系理论，加入了金融发展、贸易开放、城市化等控制变量；3. 提供了发展中国家环境经济关系的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为埃塞俄比亚政策制定者提供了CO2减排政策建议：关注环境友好型增长、提高清洁能源消费、考虑人口、城市化、贸易和金融发展的影响；2. 强调了能源消费与CO2排放的双向关系，需要综合能源政策；3. 指出城市化对环境的影响需要特别关注。

title: Can the Digital Identity Wallet be the Game-Changer in the EU's Cybercrime Battle?

detail.title: Can the Digital Identity Wallet be the Game-Changer in the EU's Cybercrime Battle?
detail.abstract:
The European Digital Identity (eIDAS) initiative aims to provide a secure and standardized
way for citizens throughout the EU member states to verify their identity online. It allows
easy and secure access to public and private online services across borders within the EU.
The central idea behind this initiative is to create a framework where users can use their
national digital identities to access services in other EU countries without additional
authentication processes. The EU Digital Identity Wallet (Digital Wallet) is a specific
application or tool individuals can use to manage their digital identity and access various
services. It intends to be a secure and user-friendly solution for storing and managing
digital credentials. The wallet is to support cross-border interoperability, allowing users to
access services in different EU countries seamlessly.

The link between these two initiatives is that the eIDAS (e.g., the DigID in the Netherlands)
is the foundation for the information stored in the Digital Wallet (dubbed eIDAS 2.0). The
digital identity is linked to a person's national identification and provides the core
authentication and authorization mechanism. The Digital Wallet is a container for various
digital credentials and personal information associated with the user's identity, including
passports, driving licenses, health/financial data, and other identification documents. By
integrating eIDAS with the Digital Wallet, the EU aims to create a unified and secure
ecosystem where citizens can easily carry their life digitally across borders and access
services conveniently.

AI.tldr: 欧盟数字身份(eIDAS)倡议旨在为欧盟成员国公民提供安全、标准化的在线身份验证方式，允许跨境访问公共服务。欧盟数字身份钱包是个人管理数字身份和访问服务的工具，支持跨境互操作性。eIDAS是数字钱包中信息的基础，两者结合创建了统一的数字生态系统。
AI.research_question: 欧盟数字身份(eIDAS)倡议和数字身份钱包如何协同工作，为欧盟公民提供跨境数字身份验证和服务访问的统一生态系统？
AI.motivation: 欧盟需要解决成员国之间数字身份验证的碎片化问题，为公民提供跨境访问公共和私人服务的便利性，同时确保安全性和标准化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字身份管理理论、跨境互操作性框架、身份验证与授权机制、数字生态系统理论
AI.method: 概念性分析、政策框架研究、技术架构描述、生态系统整合分析
AI.findings: eIDAS提供基础身份验证框架，数字钱包作为容器管理多种数字凭证，两者结合创建了统一的跨境数字身份生态系统，支持无缝服务访问。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字身份分层架构理论(eIDAS作为基础层，钱包作为应用层)，发展了跨境数字身份互操作性框架，完善了数字生态系统整合模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟公民提供跨境数字身份解决方案，简化服务访问流程，增强数字凭证管理安全性，促进欧盟内部数字单一市场发展。

title: Contract-Aware Virtual Experimentation for Tourism: Testing Sustainability Nudges with the Silicus Traveler Agent

detail.title: Contract-Aware Virtual Experimentation for Tourism: Testing Sustainability Nudges with the Silicus Traveler Agent
detail.abstract: Field experiments credibly evaluate hospitality nudges but are costly and difficult to scale. We present Silicus Traveler, a contract-aware virtual experimentation framework that conditions large-language-model (LLM) agents with tourism context and calibrates synthetic labels using small human validation samples. Replicating towel/linen reuse and buffet plate-waste interventions, Day Reconstruction Method (DRM) conditioning yields the closest match to field effects after debiasing: reuse ≈ 6.5% (benchmark ≈ 6.8%); waste ≈-32% (benchmark ≈-34%). The calibrated estimator improves 95% CI coverage and reduces MSE versus naive LLM and validation-only baselines. We state external-validity and calibration assumptions and provide guidance on validation size. Results support a situated-cognition mechanism: episodic affect stabilizes heuristics and heightens norm salience. The framework offers an ethical STEP-0 pre-testing tier for tourism sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Silicus Traveler框架，使用LLM代理进行旅游情境虚拟实验，通过小规模人工验证样本校准合成标签，有效评估酒店环保干预措施，为旅游可持续性提供伦理预测试平台。
AI.research_question: 如何利用大型语言模型(LLM)代理和有限的人工验证样本，构建一个可扩展且成本效益高的虚拟实验框架，来评估酒店环保干预措施（如毛巾/床单重复使用、自助餐盘浪费减少）的效果？
AI.motivation: 实地实验虽然能可靠评估酒店环保干预措施，但成本高昂且难以扩展。需要开发一种更经济、可扩展的替代方法来进行预测试和效果评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于情境认知理论，特别是情景情感对启发式稳定性和规范显著性的影响机制。
AI.method: 提出Silicus Traveler框架：1) 使用LLM代理模拟旅游情境；2) 采用日重建法(DRM)进行情境条件设置；3) 利用小规模人工验证样本校准合成标签；4) 复制毛巾/床单重复使用和自助餐盘浪费干预实验。
AI.findings: 经过去偏处理后，DRM条件设置的结果与实地效应最接近：重复使用率≈6.5%（基准≈6.8%）；浪费减少≈-32%（基准≈-34%）。校准估计器改善了95%置信区间覆盖范围，并减少了均方误差。
AI.theory_contributions: 支持情境认知机制：情景情感稳定启发式并提高规范显著性。为虚拟实验方法提供理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供Silicus Traveler框架作为旅游可持续性干预措施的伦理STEP-0预测试层级，降低实地实验成本，提高评估可扩展性。提供验证样本规模指导。

title: Policy Mix Matters: How Policy Design, Enforcement, and Market Pressures Shape Displacement Risk in U.S. Cities

detail.title: Policy Mix Matters: How Policy Design, Enforcement, and Market Pressures Shape Displacement Risk in U.S. Cities
detail.abstract:
Amid escalating housing affordability crises, this research examines whether tenant protection policies effectively mitigate residential displacement across four U.S. cities representing diverse regulatory regimes: New York City and San Francisco (comprehensive protections), Seattle (recent expansions), and Austin (market-oriented minimalism). Employing a mixed-methods policy matrix framework, the analysis operationalizes three dimensions: (1) policy design (coverage scope, rent regulation, just-cause eviction standards), (2) enforcement capacity (legal aid availability, administrative staffing, penalty structures), and (3) structural market moderators (rent burden, vacancy rates, poverty levels).

 Empirical indicators from Eviction Lab (2018-2024), ACS data, and Furman Center reports reveal that robust protections with strong enforcement mitigate, but do not  eliminate, displacement pressures in high-cost markets. Partial administrations show mixed results, while minimal protections correlate with elevated vulnerability. Findings synthesize comparative case analysis and descriptive statistics to identify scalable policy levers, with enforcement capacity emerging as the key differentiator across otherwise similar high-regulation environments.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法政策矩阵框架，分析美国四个城市（纽约、旧金山、西雅图、奥斯汀）的租户保护政策对住宅流离失所的影响。研究发现，强有力的保护政策配合有效执行可以缓解高成本市场的流离失所压力，但无法完全消除；执行能力是不同高监管环境的关键差异因素。
AI.research_question: 租户保护政策是否能有效缓解美国不同监管制度城市的住宅流离失所问题？
AI.motivation: 面对日益严重的住房可负担性危机，需要研究不同监管制度下租户保护政策对住宅流离失所的缓解效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合方法政策矩阵框架，包含三个维度：政策设计（覆盖范围、租金管制、正当驱逐标准）、执行能力（法律援助可用性、行政人员配备、处罚结构）、结构性市场调节因素（租金负担、空置率、贫困水平）。
AI.method: 比较案例分析结合描述性统计，使用Eviction Lab（2018-2024）、ACS数据和Furman Center报告的实证指标。
AI.findings: 强有力的保护政策配合有效执行可以缓解高成本市场的流离失所压力，但无法完全消除；部分执行显示混合结果；最低保护政策与较高的脆弱性相关；执行能力是不同高监管环境的关键差异因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个综合性的政策分析框架，强调政策执行能力在租户保护政策效果中的关键作用，为比较不同监管制度下的政策效果提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了可扩展的政策杠杆，为政策制定者提供了关于如何设计、实施和执行租户保护政策以减少住宅流离失所的具体建议，特别是在高成本住房市场中。

title: ChatGPT Generates a Novel Tax Strategy
affiliations: University of Maryland Francis King Carey School of Law, Institut Polytechnique de Paris and Johns Hopkins

detail.title: ChatGPT Generates a Novel Tax Strategy

declarations.funderStatement: This article is based on work supported by the National Science Foundation under grant No. 2204926. The authors would like to also recognize MITRE Corp. for their valuable support, assistance, and research support. Any opinions, findings, and conclusions or recommendations expressed in this article are the authors’ and do not necessarily reflect the views of the National Science Foundation or MITRE.

detail.abstract: In this article, the authors describe the first publicly disclosed novel tax minimization strategy generated by a large language model like ChatGPT.

AI.tldr: 本文首次公开披露了由大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）生成的新型税务最小化策略
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型能否生成有效的税务最小化策略？这些策略的可行性和合规性如何？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在各个领域的应用扩展，探索其在税务规划领域的潜力，特别是大型语言模型能否生成创新且合法的税务策略
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工智能在专业服务中的应用、税务规划理论、合规风险管理、技术创新扩散理论
AI.method: 使用ChatGPT等大型语言模型生成税务策略，然后通过专家评估、合规性分析和可行性测试来验证这些策略
AI.findings: 大型语言模型能够生成新颖的税务最小化策略，但这些策略需要专业评估以确保合规性和可行性
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了AI在专业服务领域的应用理论，为AI驱动的税务规划提供了理论基础，揭示了大型语言模型在复杂专业任务中的潜力
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务专业人士提供了新的工具和方法，展示了AI在税务规划中的实际应用潜力，促进了税务行业的数字化转型

title: The Dynamics of Public Attention to Islamic Finance: Interactions with Digitalization, Green Finance, and Financial Crises
affiliations: University of Lille, IPAG Business School and

detail.title: The Dynamics of Public Attention to Islamic Finance: Interactions with Digitalization, Green Finance, and Financial Crises
detail.abstract: This paper examines the determinants and dynamics of public attention to Islamic finance using monthly Google Trends data from 2004 to 2023. Employing an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) Error Correction Model, the analysis identifies both short- and long-run adjustment mechanisms linking attention to Islamic finance with attention to digitalization, conventional finance, and green finance. The empirical results reveal a dual structure in attention formation: in the short run, surges in green finance attention generate positive spillovers to Islamic finance, indicating that sustainability narratives temporarily strengthen interest in ethical and Sharia-compliant financial models. In the long run, however, attention to digitalization exerts a significant and persistent negative influence, suggesting a structural substitution effect in which the growing prominence of technology-driven financial innovations crowds out attention to Islamic finance. Attention to conventional and green finance shows no lasting effects. Crisis indicators further demonstrate that major global shocks shape information-seeking behavior: the global nancial crisis increases attention to Islamic finance, while COVID-19 produces a contractionary effect. Overall, the findings highlight the technological, informational, and crisis-related forces driving public attention to Islamic finance and contribute to the broader literature on behavioral dynamics in alternative financial systems.

AI.tldr: 使用2004-2023年谷歌趋势数据，通过ARDL误差修正模型分析伊斯兰金融公众关注度的决定因素和动态。研究发现：短期绿色金融关注度对伊斯兰金融有正向溢出效应；长期数字化关注度有显著负向影响；全球金融危机增加关注度，新冠疫情减少关注度。
AI.research_question: 伊斯兰金融公众关注度的决定因素和动态是什么？短期和长期调整机制如何将伊斯兰金融关注度与数字化、传统金融和绿色金融关注度联系起来？
AI.motivation: 理解公众对伊斯兰金融的关注模式，探索技术、信息和危机相关因素如何影响这种关注度，为替代金融系统的行为动态研究做出贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学、注意力经济学、替代金融系统理论、信息搜寻行为理论
AI.method: 使用2004-2023年谷歌趋势月度数据，采用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）误差修正模型，分析伊斯兰金融关注度与数字化、传统金融、绿色金融关注度的短期和长期关系。
AI.findings:
1. 短期：绿色金融关注度对伊斯兰金融有正向溢出效应，可持续性叙事暂时增强对伊斯兰金融的兴趣
2. 长期：数字化关注度对伊斯兰金融有显著持续的负向影响，技术驱动的金融创新挤出了对伊斯兰金融的关注
3. 传统金融和绿色金融关注度无长期影响
4. 全球金融危机增加伊斯兰金融关注度，新冠疫情减少关注度
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 揭示了伊斯兰金融公众关注度的双重结构（短期正向溢出vs长期结构性替代）
2. 扩展了替代金融系统的行为动态理论
3. 提供了技术、信息和危机相关因素影响金融关注度的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为伊斯兰金融机构制定营销和传播策略提供依据
2. 帮助政策制定者理解公众对替代金融系统的兴趣变化
3. 为投资者提供关于伊斯兰金融关注度趋势的洞察

title: Model Predictions of Gamma-Risk Evolution in Mid-Cap Options Chains *

detail.title: Model Predictions of Gamma-Risk Evolution in Mid-Cap Options Chains *
detail.abstract: Previous research explores how volatility expectations for high-liquidity earnings events are hedged using short-duration options contracts, finding that equity market participants systematically misinterpret second order (Gamma) risk profiles. This paper extends that analysis into mid-cap equities by evaluating the ability of five widely used option pricing models to predict the evolution of Gamma risk over short time horizons. The results indicate that Gamma-risk misperception increases with time-toexpiry, and that this effect is prevalent in all five models regardless of structure and sophistication.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中盘股短期期权合约中Gamma风险的错误定价问题，发现五种常用期权定价模型都存在Gamma风险误判，且到期时间越长误判越严重。
AI.research_question: 五种广泛使用的期权定价模型在预测中盘股短期Gamma风险演化方面的表现如何？Gamma风险误判是否随到期时间变化？
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现高流动性收益事件中，市场参与者系统性地误解了二阶（Gamma）风险特征。本研究将此分析扩展到中盘股，探讨期权定价模型在预测短期Gamma风险演化方面的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 期权定价理论，特别是二阶风险（Gamma风险）的定价模型，包括Black-Scholes模型及其他四种广泛使用的期权定价模型。
AI.method: 评估五种广泛使用的期权定价模型预测中盘股短期Gamma风险演化的能力，分析Gamma风险误判与到期时间的关系。
AI.findings: Gamma风险误判随到期时间增加而加剧，且这种效应在所有五种模型中普遍存在，无论模型结构和复杂程度如何。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Gamma风险误判理论到中盘股领域，揭示了期权定价模型在预测短期Gamma风险演化方面的系统性缺陷，挑战了现有期权定价模型的准确性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易者和风险管理从业者提供了重要启示：在交易中盘股短期期权时，需要特别关注Gamma风险的误判问题，尤其是在到期时间较长的情况下，这有助于改进风险管理策略和交易决策。

title: Algorithmic Fairness in AI-Based Fashion Recommendation Systems: Examining the Impact of Body Proportions on Recommendation Diversity and Exposure
affiliations: Rhode Island School of Design

detail.title: Algorithmic Fairness in AI-Based Fashion Recommendation Systems: Examining the Impact of Body Proportions on Recommendation Diversity and Exposure
detail.abstract: The increasing reliance on AI-driven recommendation systems in fashion retail has reshaped how users encounter and interpret style, shifting discovery from active exploration to algorithmically curated exposure. While existing work on algorithmic fairness has largely focused on legally protected attributes, far less attention has been given to biometric characteristics that are implicitly encoded in computer vision pipelines. This paper investigates body proportions as a non-protected yet operationally significant attribute that may systematically influence recommendation outcomes. This study examines whether users whose body proportions deviate from standardized fashion datasets receive reduced recommendation diversity and constrained aesthetic exposure. Using pose estimation via MediaPipe, normalized body proportion vectors are extracted and integrated into a hybrid neural collaborative filtering architecture. To isolate causal mechanisms, a digital twin experimental design is employed, using synthetic user profiles that are identical in behavioral preferences but differ solely in body proportions. A counterfactual "blind-to-body" baseline model that excludes biometric information is introduced to distinguish passive data bias from bias amplified through architectural design. The results show that while latent visual correlations produce baseline disparities, explicit incorporation of body proportion data significantly amplifies bias, leading to lower style diversity and disproportionate exposure to conservative, concealment-oriented clothing for non-normative body types. Notably, these effects persist even when simulated user behavior contradicts biometric stereotypes, indicating that architectural entanglement can override expressed preferences. This work argues that current fashion recommender systems conflate body morphology with stylistic intent, producing a form of algorithmic stratification that restricts access to fashion discovery. The findings highlight the need for disentangled representations and fairness metrics that account for biometric features beyond traditional protected categories.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现时尚推荐系统将身体比例数据整合到架构中会显著放大偏见，导致非标准体型用户获得更低的风格多样性和更多保守、遮盖导向的服装推荐，即使模拟用户行为与生物特征刻板印象相矛盾，这种偏见依然存在。
AI.research_question: 身体比例作为非受保护但操作上重要的属性，是否会系统性地影响时尚推荐结果？特别是，身体比例偏离标准化时尚数据集的用户是否会收到减少的推荐多样性和受限的美学曝光？
AI.motivation: 现有算法公平性研究主要关注法律保护的属性，而对计算机视觉流程中隐式编码的生物特征关注较少。时尚零售中AI推荐系统的日益依赖改变了用户发现和解读风格的方式，从主动探索转向算法策划的曝光。身体比例作为非受保护但在操作上重要的属性可能系统性地影响推荐结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法公平性理论、计算机视觉中的偏见、推荐系统架构、数字孪生实验设计、反事实分析框架
AI.method: 使用MediaPipe进行姿态估计提取归一化身体比例向量，整合到混合神经协同过滤架构中。采用数字孪生实验设计，创建行为偏好相同但仅身体比例不同的合成用户档案。引入排除生物信息的反事实"盲体"基线模型，以区分被动数据偏见与架构设计放大的偏见。
AI.findings: 结果显示：1) 潜在视觉相关性产生基线差异；2) 明确整合身体比例数据显著放大偏见；3) 非标准体型用户获得更低的风格多样性和不成比例地更多暴露于保守、遮盖导向的服装；4) 即使模拟用户行为与生物特征刻板印象相矛盾，这些效应依然存在，表明架构纠缠可以覆盖表达偏好。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 论证当前时尚推荐系统将身体形态与风格意图混为一谈，产生一种限制时尚发现访问的算法分层形式；2) 强调需要超越传统受保护类别的生物特征公平性指标；3) 提出解耦表示的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为时尚推荐系统开发者提供识别和减轻生物特征偏见的实证证据；2) 提供数字孪生实验设计和反事实基线模型的方法论框架；3) 强调在推荐系统架构设计中考虑非受保护但操作重要属性的必要性。

title: Organized Irresponsibility and Communities of Risk in a Pandemic: The Case for Legal Metamorphosis
affiliations: University of Wroclaw - Faculty of Law, Administration and Economics

detail.title: Organized Irresponsibility and Communities of Risk in a Pandemic: The Case for Legal Metamorphosis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or institutional relationships resulting in conflicts of interest, or any other influence, related to this research.
declarations.funderStatement: The article is based on research funded by the Polish National Science Centre (research project 2016/23/B/ HS5/00873: ‘Models of Legal Regulation of Risk in the Light of the Theory of Reflexivity’).

detail.abstract:
Context: The paper examines challenges that the global COVID-19 pandemic has created for responsibility frameworks and practices in law. The existential commonality of risk experienced in the pandemic is both a challenge and an opportunity for our legal systems. The pandemic has triggered a crisis in the existing concepts, principles and institutions of law.

Methodology: The methodology adopted in this paper is that of socio-legal theory, which combines an analysis of responsibility in legal theory with a social theory approach to the problem of risk. In the latter context, it builds particularly on Ulrich Beck’s theory of risk society and sociological analyses of “late modernity risks”. Although the paper focuses on domestic legal systems of nation-states, it deliberately abstracts from the particularities of any jurisdiction or branch of law, in pursuit of more general truths about legal responsibility.

Results: (a) The standard framework for responsibility in law is unfitted to the type of risks brought by the pandemic, which induces an organised irresponsibility in law. Organised irresponsibility is understood as an organisation of legal responsibility practices that results in a systemic asymmetry between produced harms and the responsibility for these harms. (b) Also, the most common legal responses to the pandemic, that is, liability shields and waivers, are inadequate, since they strengthen the organised irresponsibility. (c) What is needed is a more radical “metamorphosis” of the current responsibility framework in law. Conceptually speaking, the metamorphosis should be based on the commonality of risk experience – on “shared risk communities”. Possible normative (common but differentiated responsibility principle) and institutional (alternative compensation programmes) measures are discussed in terms of their potential to contribute to metamorphosis.

AI.tldr: COVID-19疫情暴露了现有法律责任框架的不足，引发了"组织性不负责任"问题。论文提出需要基于"共享风险共同体"概念，对法律责任框架进行根本性变革。
AI.research_question: COVID-19大流行如何挑战现有的法律责任框架和实践？法律体系应如何应对这种系统性风险带来的责任困境？
AI.motivation: 全球疫情暴露了现有法律责任框架在面对系统性风险时的不足，这种风险共同体验既是挑战也是法律体系变革的机遇。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于乌尔里希·贝克的风险社会理论和"晚期现代性风险"的社会学分析，结合法律理论中的责任分析。
AI.method: 采用社会法律理论方法，结合法律理论分析和社会理论的风险分析方法，抽象化具体司法管辖区或法律分支的特殊性。
AI.findings: 1) 标准法律责任框架不适用于疫情带来的风险类型，导致"组织性不负责任"；2) 常见的法律应对措施（责任豁免和免责条款）反而强化了这种不负责任；3) 需要基于"共享风险共同体"概念对责任框架进行根本性变革。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"组织性不负责任"概念，发展了基于风险共同体验的法律责任理论，为风险社会中的法律变革提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 讨论了可能的规范性措施（共同但有区别的责任原则）和制度性措施（替代性赔偿计划），为法律实践提供了改革方向。

title: Minimum Wages and Provision of Training
affiliations: University of Zurich and Centre for European Economic Research (ZEW), University of Würzburg - Business Administration & Economics

detail.title: Minimum Wages and Provision of Training

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No.26-003
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: We find a substantial and long-lasting positive effect of the introduction of regional minimum wages on training incidence and intensity. We apply a stacked difference-indifferences estimation to identify the dynamic effect of high minimum wages introduced in several Swiss cantons between 2018 and 2022. Employers invest more in formal training for retained employees during working hours, covering content beyond their main economic activity. We conclude that employers increase the productivity of their employees to retain the underlying rents. We carefully rule out confounding factors and offer an explanation for the difference between our and some earlier findings.

AI.tldr: 瑞士地区最低工资标准的引入显著提高了培训发生率和强度，雇主通过增加正式培训投资来提高员工生产率以保留租金
AI.research_question: 地区最低工资标准的引入如何影响企业培训投资？
AI.motivation: 理解最低工资政策对企业人力资本投资行为的影响，特别是培训决策的变化

AI.method: 堆叠双重差分法（stacked difference-in-differences），分析2018-2022年间瑞士多个州引入高最低工资标准的动态效应
AI.findings:
1. 最低工资引入对培训发生率和强度有显著且持久的正面影响
2. 雇主增加对留任员工的正式培训投资

AI.practical_contributions:

2. 帮助企业理解最低工资上涨后的适应性策略
3. 为劳动力市场政策设计提供参考

title: Status of Mungbean Production in Central Luzon
affiliations: Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III, , Pampanga State Agricultural University and Pampanga State Agricultural University

detail.title: Status of Mungbean Production in Central Luzon

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors extend their sincere gratitude to the mungbean farmers, wholesalers, retailers, agricultural extension workers from Bataan, Pampanga and Tarlac, and researchers who gave their consent and time in providing information to complete the study. The authors also deeply appreciate the reviewers of this paper for providing insights and recommendations to improve the final version of this manuscript
declarations.funderStatement: The research is financed by the authors during their course on Advanced Field Legumes as part of the requirements for the degree program on Doctor of Philosophy in Agricultural Sciences major in Crops Science at Pampanga State Agricultural University.

detail.abstract: Mungbean is the major field legume produced by farmers in Central Luzon after harvesting rice in the wet season. It requires minimal to zero tillage and less irrigation so it is best planted in the rainfed rice areas during dry season. Being the second top mungbean producer among all regions, Central Luzon needs to address the challenges in its mungbean industry to identify relative interventions towards increasing the production volume. This paper analyzed the status of the region's mungbean production through profiling of farms and farmers, analyzing cost and returns in farm production, wholesaling and retailing and identification of market chains, constraints, interventions and existing research for development programs. The lack of available quality seeds and new varieties, training provisions, extension support and fund allocation for continuous research and development limit the potential of mungbean enterprise to increase production areas and volume of yield. The proximity of Central Luzon to greater manila area where trading, processing and export activities take place gives greater potential to the region in expanding market opportunities. The concerns of farmers on labor-intensive nature of harvesting post a big challenge to the agricultural and mechanical engineers to design machineries for small farm landholdings.

AI.method: 农场和农民概况分析、生产成本与收益分析（农场生产、批发和零售）、市场链识别、制约因素分析、干预措施识别、现有研发项目分析

detail.abstract: This evaluation analyzes the Commercial Court Ordinance 2026, a landmark reform designed to modernize Bangladesh's judicial infrastructure by decoupling high-stakes business disputes from the general civil docket. Prepared by Judge Nazmul Hasan, a Senior Judicial Magistrate and 11th BJS officer who was a Prime Minister Gold Medalist , the document highlights the shift toward time-bound, technology-driven adjudication. It explores the implementation of mandatory mediation, summary judgments, and specialized case management to enhance investor confidence as Bangladesh prepares for LDC graduation

title: Unleashing the Power of Play: Gamification Strategies for Enhancing Student Learning in the Classroom

detail.title: Unleashing the Power of Play: Gamification Strategies for Enhancing Student Learning in the Classroom
detail.abstract: In recent years, gamification has emerged as a promising approach to enhance student learning in educational settings. By integrating game elements into the learning process, educators can foster increased engagement, motivation, and retention among students. This research article explores the various gamification strategies employed in classrooms and their impact on student learning outcomes. Through a comprehensive review of literature and analysis of case studies, this paper highlights the effectiveness of gamification in enhancing student engagement and motivation across different subject areas. Furthermore, practical recommendations are provided for educators looking to integrate gamification into their teaching practices to create more dynamic and interactive learning environments. This research article aims to explore the potential of gamification in enhancing student learning in the classroom. Through a review of existing literature and analysis of case studies, we will examine the various gamification strategies employed by educators and their impact on student engagement, motivation, and learning outcomes. Additionally, practical recommendations will be provided for educators interested in implementing gamification techniques in their own teaching practices.
