title: Understanding Financial Inclusion: Patterns and Determinants of Formal Borrowing in India
affiliations: Eton College

detail.title: Understanding Financial Inclusion: Patterns and Determinants of Formal Borrowing in India
detail.abstract: Financial inclusion plays a major role in household welfare and economic freedom in India, where borrowing is often needed to finance consumption, agriculture, housing and emergencies like health shocks. The paper examines the household characteristics' association with formal credit access and documents the structural patterns that continue to shape the borrowing landscape across the country. The study exploits the nationally representative All India Debt and Investment Survey (AIDIS), 2019 employing OLS and Logit regression models with fixed effects at the state and district level. MPCE, a proxy for well-being, is positively associated with an increase in formal borrowing, by ~1% per thousand rupees. Household size has a small negative effect on formal borrowing. The SCs and STs are less likely to avail credit from formal sources compared to OBCs, whereas the 'Others' caste are more likely to avail credit than OBCs. Muslim and Christian households are also less likely to have access to formal loans. The study highlights the role of loan purpose and relative urgency in shaping borrowing behaviour. Addressing structural inequality in the credit market will require policies that explicitly recognise and counteract social disadvantage, rather than assuming that broader financial development will automatically translate into equal access.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用印度全国代表性债务与投资调查数据，分析家庭特征与正规信贷获取的关系，发现种姓、宗教、家庭规模等因素显著影响正规信贷获取，揭示了信贷市场中的结构性不平等问题。
AI.research_question: 印度家庭特征如何影响正规信贷获取？信贷市场存在哪些结构性不平等模式？
AI.motivation: 金融包容性对印度家庭福利和经济自由至关重要，但信贷获取存在不平等，需要理解影响正规信贷获取的家庭特征和结构性障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融包容性理论、信贷配给理论和社会分层理论，分析种姓、宗教、收入等社会人口因素对信贷获取的影响。
AI.method: 使用2019年全印度债务与投资调查（AIDIS）全国代表性数据，采用OLS和Logit回归模型，控制州和地区固定效应。
AI.findings: 1. 人均月消费支出（MPCE）每增加1000卢比，正规借贷增加约1%；2. 家庭规模对正规借贷有轻微负效应；3. SC和ST种姓比OBC更少获得正规信贷，而"其他"种姓比OBC更多；4. 穆斯林和基督教家庭获得正规贷款的可能性更低；5. 贷款目的和紧急程度影响借贷行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 实证验证了印度信贷市场中的结构性不平等；2. 揭示了种姓和宗教在信贷获取中的持续影响；3. 强调了社会分层理论在金融包容性研究中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定需要明确识别和抵消社会劣势；2. 不能假设广泛的金融发展会自动转化为平等获取；3. 需要针对弱势群体的定向信贷政策。

title: Cultural Determinants of Private Final Consumption Expenditure (PFCE) in India: A Conceptual and Structural Analysis

detail.title: Cultural Determinants of Private Final Consumption Expenditure (PFCE) in India: A Conceptual and Structural Analysis

declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a working paper. Comments and suggestions are welcome.

detail.abstract: Private Final Consumption Expenditure (PFCE) accounts for nearly 60 per cent of India’s Gross Domestic Product, making household consumption a critical driver of economic growth. Unlike many Western economies, consumption behaviour in India is deeply shaped by cultural factors such as religious diversity, regional traditions, family structures, social norms, and long-standing community values. This paper examines the cultural foundations influencing PFCE patterns in India through a conceptual and structural analysis based on secondary data sources. Using published national accounts, economic reports, and interdisciplinary literature from economics, sociology, and cultural studies, the study explores how cultural values affect consumption choices, savings behavior, sectoral expenditure patterns, and aggregate demand. The analysis highlights the role of festivals, household decision-making systems, regional food habits, and social customs in shaping India’s consumption structure across key PFCE components. The paper argues that conventional economic models, which largely ignore cultural determinants, provide an incomplete understanding of consumption behavior in the Indian context. The study concludes that integrating cultural dimensions into PFCE analysis is essential for accurate economic forecasting and effective policy design, and it outlines future research directions for empirically modelling culture–economy linkages in India.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨印度私人最终消费支出(PFCE)的文化基础，指出传统经济模型忽视文化因素导致对印度消费行为的理解不完整，强调将文化维度纳入分析对经济预测和政策设计的重要性。
AI.research_question: 文化因素如何影响印度的私人最终消费支出(PFCE)模式？
AI.motivation: PFCE占印度GDP近60%，是经济增长的关键驱动力。与许多西方经济体不同，印度的消费行为深受宗教多样性、区域传统、家庭结构、社会规范和社区价值观等文化因素的影响。传统经济模型大多忽略文化决定因素，导致对印度消费行为的理解不完整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合经济学、社会学和文化研究的跨学科理论框架，探讨文化价值观如何影响消费选择、储蓄行为、部门支出模式和总需求。
AI.method: 基于二手数据源的概念性和结构性分析，使用已发布的国家账户、经济报告以及经济学、社会学和文化研究的跨学科文献。
AI.findings: 文化因素如节日、家庭决策系统、区域饮食习惯和社会习俗在塑造印度主要PFCE组成部分的消费结构中起着关键作用。这些文化维度显著影响消费模式，传统经济模型无法充分解释这些现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战传统经济模型忽视文化决定因素的局限性；2. 提出将文化维度纳入消费分析的理论框架；3. 为理解文化-经济联系提供概念基础；4. 为未来实证建模文化-经济联系指明研究方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为准确的经济预测提供更全面的分析框架；2. 为有效的政策设计提供文化敏感的建议；3. 帮助政策制定者更好地理解印度独特的消费模式；4. 为企业制定市场策略提供文化洞察。

title: A Few Remarks about the Albanian Articles System: Stages of Post Positioning in Albanian
affiliations: UBT, Kosova and University of Prizren

detail.title: A Few Remarks about the Albanian Articles System: Stages of Post Positioning in Albanian

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The paper is for linguistics.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is the new paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No!

detail.abstract: The article case forms generally owe their origin to the case forms of the demonstrative pronoun a-i/a-y-ajo or ata. In the course of time, however, such case forms have undergone various phonetic and analogical changes, which are discreetly described in the Albanian language version. Suffice it to cite here the already mentioned accusative singular form of the postpositive articlenë, which has most probably evolved from the merger of the ancient accusative case ending-n with the accusative form of demonstrative pronoun a-të, tan < ton. The creation of the stressed or unstressed pronominal form opposition in Albanian and some other Balkan and non-Balkan languages is an obvious innovation as compared to the ancient Indo-European type. The aim of this paper has the author presents the former hypotheses on the source of the postpositioning of the article in Balkan languages and the critical or view of the results achieved by Albanian, Rumanian, Slavonic, Bulgarian, Macedonian, Serbovroat and English or German languages. Based on the examination of the actual use of the definite article as well as on the analysis of the documented relics in these languages the author (B.Bokshi).

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了巴尔干语言中后置定冠词的起源，特别是阿尔巴尼亚语中格形式的演变，认为它们源于指示代词a-i/a-y-ajo或ata的格形式，并经历了语音和类比变化。
AI.research_question: 巴尔干语言中后置定冠词的来源是什么？阿尔巴尼亚语及其他巴尔干语言中格形式如何从指示代词演变而来？
AI.motivation: 理解巴尔干语言中后置定冠词的历史起源和演变过程，澄清现有假设并基于实际语言使用和文献遗迹进行分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 历史语言学、比较语言学、巴尔干语言学、印欧语系语言演变理论。
AI.method: 基于对阿尔巴尼亚语、罗马尼亚语、斯拉夫语、保加利亚语、马其顿语、塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语、英语和德语等语言的实际使用和文献遗迹的分析。
AI.findings: 阿尔巴尼亚语格形式起源于指示代词a-i/a-y-ajo或ata的格形式，经历了语音和类比变化；后置定冠词në可能来自古代宾格词尾-n与指示代词a-të的合并；阿尔巴尼亚语等语言中重读与非重读代词形式的对立是相对于古印欧语类型的创新。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了巴尔干语言后置定冠词起源的新解释，阐明了阿尔巴尼亚语格形式的演变机制，对巴尔干语言接触和演变理论有贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于阿尔巴尼亚语教学和历史研究，为其他巴尔干语言研究提供参考，对语言类型学和历史比较语言学有实用价值。

title: The Complete Mathematics of Transformers: A Rigorous Treatment with Full Derivations, Proofs, and Theoretical Foundations
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: The Complete Mathematics of Transformers: A Rigorous Treatment with Full Derivations, Proofs, and Theoretical Foundations
detail.abstract: We give a rigorous mathematical synthesis of the transformer architecture and identify a set of sufficient structural conditions under which attention-like residual updates arise naturally. We provide (i) a group-theoretic characterization of permutation-equivariant maps, (ii) explicit sub-exponential concentration of dot products and the resulting 1/ √ d k scaling, (iii) global Lipschitz bounds for softmax via its Fisher-metric Jacobian, (iv) spectral theory of doubly stochastic operators for manifold-constrained hyper-connections (mHC), and (v) precise connections between attention and kernel smoothing / nonparametric regression. Where claims require additional axioms (e.g. uniqueness of softmax or inevitability of a particular architectural choice), we state them explicitly and separate theorem from programmatic conjecture. The document develops complete mathematical foundations with full proofs. We establish: the Deep Sets characterization of permutation-equivariant linear maps (dimension 2dm) [35]; sub-exponential concentration of dot products via explicit MGF analysis; the global 1 2-Lipschitz bound of softmax with information-geometric interpretation as the Fisher metric; spectral theory of doubly stochastic matrices ensuring ∥H res ∥ 2 = 1; self-attention as reverse Wasserstein gradient flow on the sphere with Dirac collapse at equilibrium; multi-head attention as subspace ensemble; in-context learning as implicit gradient descent (linear attention) or kernel regression (softmax attention); and universal approximation with explicit depth/width rates. The central thesis is that transformers implement flows on manifolds (attention as gradient flow on S d-1), stabilized by isometries (RoPE rotations, doubly stochastic mixing, variance-preserving scaling), performing meta-optimization via kernel methods (ICL as non-parametric regression). We formalize "inevitability" as a conjecture under explicit axioms (Luce/IIA for softmax uniqueness), rather than claiming it as a theorem from equivariance and boundedness alone.

AI.tldr: 本文对Transformer架构进行了严格的数学综合，识别了注意力类残差更新自然出现的充分结构条件。论文建立了完整的数学基础，包括置换等变映射的群论特征、点积的亚指数集中性、softmax的全局Lipschitz界、双随机算子的谱理论，以及注意力与核平滑/非参数回归的精确联系。核心论点是Transformer在流形上实现流（注意力作为S^{d-1}上的梯度流），通过等距变换稳定，并通过核方法执行元优化。
AI.research_question: 在什么结构条件下，注意力类残差更新会自然出现？Transformer架构的数学本质是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管Transformer在深度学习领域取得了巨大成功，但其数学基础仍然不够完善。现有研究缺乏对注意力机制内在数学结构的严格分析，特别是关于其"必然性"的讨论往往基于直觉而非严谨证明。本文旨在为Transformer架构提供完整的数学综合，从群论、概率论、信息几何和谱理论等多个角度建立严格的理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 群论：置换等变映射的Deep Sets特征化；2. 概率论：点积的亚指数集中性和1/√d_k缩放；3. 信息几何：softmax的Fisher度量Jacobian和全局Lipschitz界；4. 谱理论：双随机算子的谱性质；5. 流形理论：注意力作为球面上的梯度流；6. 核方法：上下文学习作为非参数回归。
AI.method: 采用纯数学分析方法：1. 群论特征化证明；2. 矩生成函数分析点积集中性；3. Fisher度量推导softmax Lipschitz界；4. 谱理论分析双随机矩阵；5. Wasserstein梯度流理论；6. 核回归理论分析上下文学习；7. 通用逼近理论分析深度/宽度率。
AI.findings: 1. 置换等变线性映射的维度为2dm；2. 点积具有亚指数集中性，导致1/√d_k缩放；3. softmax具有全局1/2-Lipschitz界；4. 双随机矩阵确保∥H_res∥_2 = 1；5. 自注意力是球面上的反向Wasserstein梯度流；6. 多头注意力是子空间集成；7. 上下文学习是隐式梯度下降（线性注意力）或核回归（softmax注意力）；8. 具有显式深度/宽度率的通用逼近能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为Transformer架构提供了完整的数学基础；2. 建立了注意力机制与流形梯度流的精确联系；3. 形式化了"必然性"作为明确公理下的猜想；4. 统一了多个数学视角（群论、概率论、信息几何、谱理论）；5. 建立了注意力与核方法的理论联系；6. 提供了严格的证明和显式的收敛率。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为Transformer架构设计提供了理论指导；2. 解释了缩放因子1/√d_k的理论基础；3. 为注意力机制的稳定性分析提供了数学工具；4. 为上下文学习的理论理解提供了框架；5. 为Transformer的架构选择提供了公理化基础；6. 为未来的架构创新提供了数学语言。

title: PMC Index-Based Study on Policy Synergy for Sustainable AI in China's Digital Cultural Industries
affiliations: Tongji University and

detail.title: PMC Index-Based Study on Policy Synergy for Sustainable AI in China's Digital Cultural Industries
detail.abstract: This paper applies the Policy Modeling Consistency (PMC) index model to quantitatively evaluate 32 Chinese policies (2016-2025) promoting artificial intelligence (AI) in digital cultural industries (DCIs). Focusing on policy synergy for sustainable AI, the analysis assesses ten primary variables-including policy objectives, instruments, sustainability integration, and application levels-across national and local initiatives. Results reveal an overall 'Excellent' average PMC score, indicating robust policy design in economic or technological domains. However, some low-grade policies prioritize short-term regulation over sustainable governance. The study recommends embedding 'human-centricity' and 'ethical risk assessment' in sustainability indicators, alongside cultural diversity safeguards (e.g., algorithmic support for intangible heritage). These optimizations can reframe AI as a sociocultural enabler-not merely a technical tool-advancing equitable, innovative, and ecologically resilient DCIs aligned with Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

AI.tldr: 本研究运用PMC指数模型定量评估了2016-2025年间32项中国促进数字文化产业人工智能发展的政策，聚焦可持续AI的政策协同。结果显示政策设计整体优秀，但部分政策过于侧重短期监管而忽视可持续治理。研究建议在可持续指标中嵌入"以人为本"和"伦理风险评估"，并加强文化多样性保护。
AI.research_question: 中国促进数字文化产业人工智能发展的政策协同效果如何？这些政策在推动可持续AI发展方面存在哪些不足？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在数字文化产业中的广泛应用，需要评估相关政策是否有效促进可持续AI发展，确保AI不仅作为技术工具，更能成为社会文化赋能者，推动公平、创新和生态韧性的数字文化产业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策建模一致性（PMC）指数模型，可持续AI理论，政策协同理论，可持续发展目标（SDGs）框架。
AI.method: 采用PMC指数模型对32项中国国家与地方层面的人工智能促进数字文化产业政策（2016-2025年）进行定量评估，分析10个主要变量：政策目标、政策工具、可持续性整合、应用水平等。
AI.findings: 政策整体PMC平均得分"优秀"，表明在经济和技术领域的政策设计稳健。但部分低等级政策过于关注短期监管而忽视可持续治理。政策在可持续性整合方面存在不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了PMC指数模型在数字文化产业政策评估中的应用，提出了将"以人为本"和"伦理风险评估"嵌入可持续AI政策框架的理论视角，为政策协同研究提供了新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了优化建议：在可持续指标中嵌入"以人为本"和"伦理风险评估"，建立文化多样性保护机制（如算法支持非物质文化遗产），将AI重新定位为社会文化赋能者而非单纯技术工具，推动数字文化产业与SDGs对齐。

title: The Hidden Fault Line: How Centralized Exchange Infrastructure Amplifies Stablecoin Risk
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: The Hidden Fault Line: How Centralized Exchange Infrastructure Amplifies Stablecoin Risk
detail.abstract: On October 11, 2025, Ethena's USDe stablecoin collapsed to $0.65 on Binance while holding dollar parity on every other cryptocurrency exchange, a $283 million crisis contained entirely within a single platform's infrastructure. This article argues that the event exposes a critical gap in emerging crypto regulation: while the GENIUS Act and proposed CLARITY Act establish frameworks for asset classification, they fail to address systemic risks arising from the opaque, leveraged infrastructure of centralized exchanges. Through analysis of the Binance crash, this article demonstrates that USDe's failure was architectural, not algorithmic. Binance's reliance on internal order books for collateral pricing, its concentration of $5 billion in USDe without corresponding liquidity, and its automated liquidation systems created a destructive feedback loop. The protocol functioned normally; however, the exchange infrastructure failed. This article proposes a paradigm shift from asset-centric to system-centric regulatory oversight, outlining four principles for governing systemically important crypto exchanges: mandatory infrastructure transparency, collateral suitability standards, robust oracle requirements with circuit breakers, and stress testing under extreme scenarios. Drawing on regulatory responses to traditional finance crises, these principles address the ungoverned space where innovative assets interact with fragile market infrastructure. Without system-centric regulation, the next USDe-scale event may not be contained to a single platform, and regulators should act before the next crisis forces their hand.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年10月11日Ethena的USDe稳定币在币安交易所崩溃至0.65美元的事件，指出这暴露了加密监管的关键缺陷：现有法规关注资产分类，却忽视了中心化交易所不透明、杠杆化基础设施的系统性风险。文章主张从资产中心监管转向系统中心监管。
AI.research_question: 现有加密监管框架（如GENIUS法案和CLARITY法案）如何未能解决中心化交易所基础设施的系统性风险？
AI.motivation: 2025年10月11日，Ethena的USDe稳定币在币安交易所崩溃至0.65美元，而其他交易所仍保持美元平价，这一283亿美元的危机完全局限于单一平台基础设施。这一事件暴露了新兴加密监管的关键缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、市场基础设施脆弱性、监管框架分析、传统金融危机应对经验
AI.method: 通过对币安崩溃事件的分析，包括交易所内部订单簿定价机制、流动性集中问题、自动清算系统等基础设施要素的考察
AI.findings: USDe的失败是架构性的而非算法性的。币安依赖内部订单簿进行抵押品定价、集中了50亿美元USDe而没有相应流动性、其自动清算系统形成了破坏性反馈循环。协议本身正常运行，但交易所基础设施失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从资产中心监管向系统中心监管的范式转变，强调监管应关注交易所基础设施而非仅仅资产分类。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了治理系统性重要加密交易所的四项原则：强制性基础设施透明度、抵押品适用性标准、具有断路器的稳健预言机要求、极端情景下的压力测试。

title: From Rough to Multifractal Multidimensional Volatility: A Multidimensional Log S-Fbm Model
affiliations: CEREMADE, CMAP CNRS-UMR 7641 and Ecole Polytechnique and University of Corsica

detail.title: From Rough to Multifractal Multidimensional Volatility: A Multidimensional Log S-Fbm Model
detail.abstract: We introduce the multivariate Log S-fBM model (mLog S-fBM), extending the univariate framework proposed by Wu et al.  to the multidimensional setting. We begin by defining the multidimensional Stationary fractional Brownian motion (mS-fBM). This process is characterized by marginals following S-fBM dynamics and a specific cross-covariance structure. It is parametrized by a correlation scale T,  intermittency parameters and Hurst exponents, as well as their multidimensional counterparts: the co-intermittency matrix and the co-Hurst matrix. The mLog S-fBM is then constructed by modeling the volatility components as exponentials of the mS-fBM, thereby preserving the dependence structure encoded in the Gaussian core. We establish that the mLog S-fBM is well-defined for any co-Hurst matrix with entries in [0, 1/2[. Notably, the model supports vanishing co-Hurst parameters, allowing it to bridge the rough volatility and multifractal regimes. Furthermore, we generalize the small intermittency approximation technique to the multivariate setting to develop an efficient Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) calibration procedure. This method relies on estimating the cross-covariance parameters for pairs of marginals. We validate the procedure on synthetic data and subsequently apply it to S&P 500 market data, modeling stock return fluctuations within this multivariate stochastic volatility framework. In particular, diagonal estimates of the stock Hurst matrix, corresponding to single-stock log-volatility Hurst exponents, are consistently found to be close to 0, indicating a multifractal behavior in agreement with the findings of  Wu et al. . Conversely, we observe that the co-Hurst matrix off-diagonal entries are close to the Hurst exponent of the S&P 500 index itself (H ≈ 0.12), consistent with the rough volatility literature, while the off-diagonal entries of the co-intermittency matrix align closely with univariate intermittency estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多元Log S-fBM模型，将单变量框架扩展到多维设置，建立了包含相关尺度、间歇参数、Hurst指数及其多维对应物的随机波动率模型，并开发了有效的GMM校准方法，应用于S&P 500市场数据验证了模型的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何将单变量Log S-fBM模型扩展到多维设置，以建模股票收益波动的多元随机波动率框架？
AI.motivation: 现有单变量随机波动率模型无法充分捕捉多个资产间的依赖结构，需要开发能够同时建模多个资产波动率动态及其相关性的多维框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多维平稳分数布朗运动(mS-fBM)理论，通过定义相关尺度、间歇参数、Hurst指数及其多维对应物（共间歇矩阵和共Hurst矩阵），构建多元Log S-fBM模型。
AI.method: 1. 定义mS-fBM过程；2. 构建mLog S-fBM模型；3. 将小间歇近似技术扩展到多元设置；4. 开发广义矩估计(GMM)校准程序；5. 在合成数据和S&P 500市场数据上验证。
AI.findings: 1. mLog S-fBM模型在共Hurst矩阵条目在[0, 1/2[范围内时定义良好；2. 支持消失的共Hurst参数，连接粗糙波动率和多重分形机制；3. 股票Hurst矩阵对角线估计接近0，表明多重分形行为；4. 共Hurst矩阵非对角线条目接近S&P 500指数的Hurst指数(H≈0.12)，与粗糙波动率文献一致；5. 共间歇矩阵非对角线条目与单变量间歇估计一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将Log S-fBM模型扩展到多维设置；2. 建立了包含共Hurst矩阵和共间歇矩阵的完整理论框架；3. 证明了模型在特定参数范围内的良好定义性；4. 提供了连接粗糙波动率和多重分形机制的理论桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了高效的GMM校准方法；2. 提供了适用于实际市场数据的多元随机波动率建模工具；3. 验证了模型在S&P 500市场数据上的适用性；4. 为投资组合风险管理提供了更准确的波动率依赖结构建模方法。

Texas A&M University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper

detail.abstract: In light of the scientific and historical factors that have shaped the development of groundwater law and policy, this chapter seeks to provide a primarily descriptive account of its current state in the United States and to lay a foundation for future efforts to address gaps in the regime. Section 8B.02 considers the importance of groundwater in modern American society, with a particular focus on its uses and the threats these resources face. Section 8B.03 describes the U.S. framework for the domestic governance of groundwater resources. Section 8B.04 describes the mechanisms for transboundary governance of groundwater between the United States and its neighbors, Mexico and Canada. Section 8B.05 summarizes gaps in and future challenges for responsible groundwater governance in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本章对美国地下水法律与政策的现状进行了描述性分析，探讨了其科学和历史背景，并指出了未来需要解决的治理缺口。
AI.research_question: 美国地下水法律与政策的现状如何？存在哪些治理缺口和未来挑战？
AI.motivation: 地下水在美国社会中具有重要地位，但面临着各种威胁，现有法律政策体系存在缺口，需要系统梳理现状以为未来改进奠定基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于科学和历史因素对法律政策发展的影响，采用描述性分析框架，涵盖国内治理和跨境治理两个维度。
AI.method: 文献综述和描述性分析，系统梳理美国地下水法律政策体系，包括国内治理框架和跨境治理机制。
AI.findings: 1. 地下水在美国社会中的重要性及其面临的威胁；2. 美国国内地下水治理框架；3. 美墨、美加跨境地下水治理机制；4. 现有治理体系中的缺口和未来挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解科学和历史因素如何塑造地下水法律政策提供了分析框架，为未来法律政策研究奠定了基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了美国地下水治理现状的全面描述，指出了需要改进的领域，为未来治理改革提供了参考依据。

title: The Semantic Risk Premium

detail.title: The Semantic Risk Premium
detail.abstract: Prediction markets aggregate information through prices, yet their efficacy depends critically on the clarity of contract language. We introduce the Semantic Risk Score (SRS), a novel measure of linguistic ambiguity in prediction market contracts derived from large language model predictions of dispute probability. Using dispute data from the UMA Protocol (N = 804) to validate our measure, we demonstrate that SRS correlates significantly with actual oracle dispute variance (ρ = 0.157, p < 0.001). Applying this validated instrument to Polymarket contracts (N = 246), we find that semantic risk manifests through liquidity withdrawal: a one-standard-deviation increase in SRS is associated with a substantial collapse in trading volume (t =-4.41, p < 0.001). Paradoxically, high-ambiguity markets converge faster to extreme prices, which we attribute to adverse selection: sophisticated traders exit ambiguous markets, leaving homogeneous participants who rapidly reach false consensus. Our findings extend the Market for Lemons framework to prediction markets and have implications for contract design, portfolio optimization, and decentralized oracle governance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种衡量预测市场合约语言模糊性的新指标——语义风险评分(SRS)，发现语言模糊性会导致流动性枯竭和虚假共识，将"柠檬市场"理论扩展到预测市场领域。
AI.research_question: 预测市场合约的语言模糊性如何影响市场效率和价格发现过程？
AI.motivation: 预测市场通过价格聚合信息，但其有效性严重依赖合约语言的清晰度。目前缺乏量化语言模糊性及其对市场影响的方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"柠檬市场"理论，将信息不对称和逆向选择框架扩展到预测市场；使用大型语言模型量化语义风险。
AI.method: 1. 提出语义风险评分(SRS)，利用LLM预测争议概率；2. 使用UMA协议数据(N=804)验证SRS；3. 应用SRS分析Polymarket合约(N=246)的市场行为。
AI.findings: 1. SRS与预言机争议方差显著相关(ρ=0.157, p<0.001)；2. SRS增加导致交易量大幅下降(t=-4.41, p<0.001)；3. 高模糊性市场更快收敛到极端价格，源于逆向选择导致的虚假共识。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将"柠檬市场"理论扩展到预测市场；2. 提出首个量化合约语言模糊性的方法；3. 揭示语言模糊性如何通过逆向选择影响市场动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为合约设计提供改进建议；2. 为投资组合优化提供风险指标；3. 为去中心化预言机治理提供决策依据。

title: The History of Mathematics in Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence in Finance Institute

detail.title: The History of Mathematics in Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence is often narrated as an engineering story: faster hardware, larger datasets, and empirical tricks. This paper presents a different thesis: each major era of AI corresponds to a mathematical redefinition of intelligence. From Boolean logic and first-order proof systems (intelligence as derivability), through computability and complexity (intelligence as effective procedure), to probability and graphical models (intelligence as belief under uncertainty), optimization and statistical learning theory (intelligence as empirical risk minimization and generalization), and modern deep learning (intelligence as learned representation realized in high-dimensional geometry and operator-like architectures such as attention). The account is explicitly chronological and emphasizes why specific mathematical ideas became decisive at particular historical moments: which bottlenecks they removed, which impossibility results they exposed, and which algorithms they enabled. We argue that future paradigm shifts will again arise from new mathematics: compositional categories, symmetries and representation theory, geometric measure theory in high dimensions, and principled objectives for agency and alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI发展史本质上是数学对智能的重新定义史，而非单纯的工程进步。每个AI时代都对应着不同的数学框架对智能的重新定义，未来范式转变将再次源于新数学。
AI.research_question: AI发展的本质是什么？为什么特定的数学思想在特定历史时刻变得决定性？未来AI范式转变将如何发生？
AI.motivation: 反驳将AI叙述为单纯工程故事（更快硬件、更大数据集、经验技巧）的流行观点，揭示数学在AI发展中的核心作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 智能的数学定义演化框架：布尔逻辑和一阶证明系统（智能作为可推导性）、可计算性和复杂性（智能作为有效程序）、概率和图模型（智能作为不确定性下的信念）、优化和统计学习理论（智能作为经验风险最小化和泛化）、现代深度学习（智能作为高维几何中的学习表示和注意力等算子架构）。
AI.method: 历史分析方法，按时间顺序分析AI发展，考察特定数学思想在特定历史时刻的决定性作用，包括它们解决的瓶颈、揭示的不可能性结果以及启发的算法。
AI.findings: AI发展史本质上是数学对智能的重新定义史；每个AI时代都对应着不同的数学框架；特定数学思想在特定历史时刻变得决定性是因为它们解决了当时的瓶颈、揭示了不可能性结果并启发了新算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI发展的数学定义演化理论框架；揭示了数学在AI发展中的核心作用而非单纯工程进步；提供了理解AI历史发展的新视角；预测了未来范式转变将源于新数学。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助AI研究者和实践者理解AI发展的本质规律；为未来AI研究提供方向性指导（关注组合范畴、对称性和表示理论、高维几何测度论、智能体和对齐的原则性目标等数学领域）；促进数学与AI的交叉融合。

title: Central Bank Digital Currency, Flight-to-Quality, and Bank-Runs in an Agent-Based Model
affiliations: Politecnico di Milano - Department of Mathematics, University of Bamberg - Department of Economics, Complexity Lab in Economics - CLE, Catholic University of Milan, City University London - Department of Economics and Polytechnic University of Milan - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Central Bank Digital Currency, Flight-to-Quality, and Bank-Runs in an Agent-Based Model

publicationDetails.detailsText: Ca' Foscari University of Venice, Department of Economics Research Paper Series No. 01/2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Department of Economics, Ca' Foscari University of Venice Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We analyse financial stability and welfare impacts associated with the introduction of a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) in a macroeconomic agent-based model. The model considers firms, banks, and households interacting on labour, goods, credit, and interbank markets. Households move their liquidity from deposits to CBDC based on the perceived riskiness of their banks. We find that the introduction of CBDC exacerbates bank-runs and may lead to financial instability phenomena. The effect can be changed by introducing a limit on CBDC holdings. The adoption of CBDC has little effect on macroeconomic variables but the interest rate on loans to firms goes up and credit goes down in a limited way. CBDC leads to a redistribution of wealth from firms and banks to households with a higher bank default rate. CBDC may have negative welfare effects, but a bound on holding enables a welfare improvement.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用基于主体的宏观经济模型分析央行数字货币（CBDC）对金融稳定和福利的影响。研究发现CBDC可能加剧银行挤兑、导致金融不稳定，但对宏观经济变量影响有限。设置CBDC持有上限可以改善福利效果。
AI.research_question: 央行数字货币（CBDC）的引入如何影响金融稳定性和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 随着各国央行考虑推出数字货币，需要理解CBDC对金融体系的潜在影响，特别是可能引发的银行挤兑风险和金融不稳定问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主体的宏观经济模型（Agent-Based Macroeconomic Model），考虑企业、银行和家庭在劳动力、商品、信贷和银行间市场的互动。
AI.method: 使用基于主体的宏观经济模型进行模拟分析，模型中家庭根据银行风险感知将流动性从存款转移到CBDC。
AI.findings: 1. CBDC引入加剧银行挤兑，可能导致金融不稳定；2. 设置CBDC持有上限可以改变这种效应；3. CBDC对宏观经济变量影响有限，但企业贷款利率上升，信贷适度下降；4. CBDC导致财富从企业和银行向家庭再分配，银行违约率上升；5. CBDC可能有负面福利效应，但设置持有上限可改善福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在基于主体的宏观经济模型中系统分析CBDC的金融稳定效应；2. 揭示了CBDC可能通过存款转移机制加剧银行挤兑的理论机制；3. 提出了CBDC持有上限作为缓解金融不稳定性的政策工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行设计CBDC政策提供实证依据，建议考虑设置持有上限；2. 警示政策制定者CBDC可能带来的金融稳定风险；3. 为监管机构评估CBDC对信贷市场和财富分配的影响提供参考。

title: Default-Triggered Acquisition (I): Pricing Risky Bond with Potential Buyers of the Distressed Firm
affiliations: Independent and The University of Sydney

detail.title: Default-Triggered Acquisition (I): Pricing Risky Bond with Potential Buyers of the Distressed Firm
detail.abstract: This paper develops a structural model of the defaultable bond, in which default-triggered acquisition opportunities are taken into account. In this model, post-default acquisition is treated as an event that is triggered when the alternative valuation of the firm's assets exceeds the failing firm's value, and covers the acquisition costs, which are essentially the conceded debt liability. Analytical results are derived for the cases where default time is assumed either to be fixed (as in Merton (1974)), or random (as in Black and Cox (1976)), and where there are one or more alternative valuations. This paper contributes to the literature on debt recovery by suggesting an analytical structure on the recovery rate. Abstract Addendum (2026): While originally developed to address the structural gap in debt recovery modeling, this framework provides timely analytical tools for today's distressed debt environment, where 'alternative valuations' from private equity and strategic buyers are the primary drivers of recovery. * We are very grateful to Chiaki Hara, William Perraudin and Donald Robertson for their insightful comments on this paper. We would also like to thank the Cambridge Overseas Trust for their financial support.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个考虑违约触发收购机会的可违约债券结构模型，将违约后收购视为当企业资产的替代估值超过失败企业价值并覆盖收购成本（主要是承担的债务责任）时触发的事件。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个考虑违约触发收购机会的可违约债券结构模型，为债务回收率提供分析框架？
AI.motivation: 现有债务回收模型存在结构性缺口，特别是在当前困境债务环境中，来自私募股权和战略买家的"替代估值"成为回收的主要驱动因素，需要建立更全面的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Merton(1974)的固定违约时间模型和Black & Cox(1976)的随机违约时间模型，结合企业资产替代估值理论，构建违约触发收购的结构模型。
AI.method: 开发结构模型，将违约后收购视为触发事件，分析固定违约时间和随机违约时间两种情况，考虑单一或多个替代估值情景，推导债务回收率的解析结果。
AI.findings: 建立了考虑违约触发收购机会的债务回收分析框架，为债务回收率提供了结构化的解析方法，特别适用于当前困境债务环境中替代估值驱动的回收情景。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了债务回收模型的结构性缺口，将违约后收购机会纳入分析框架，为债务回收率提供了新的理论分析结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前困境债务环境提供了及时的分析工具，帮助投资者评估来自私募股权和战略买家的替代估值对债务回收的影响，提升债务定价和风险管理能力。

title: Lost in Aggregation: Behind the Facade of Eurozone Business Cycle Comovement
affiliations: Lazarski University and University of Piraeus - Department of Economics

detail.title: Lost in Aggregation: Behind the Facade of Eurozone Business Cycle Comovement

declarations.funderStatement: This article was prepared within the research project “Bayesian simultaneous equations model averaging - theoretical development and R package,” funded by the Polish National Science Centre, on the basis of the decision No. DEC-2021/43/B/HS4/01745

detail.abstract: Using data from 51 NUTS 1 regions and six sectors across nine Eurozone countries over 1980-2019, we employ a Bayesian dynamic latent factor model to examine business cycle (BC) synchronization in the Eurozone at a disaggregated regional, sectoral, and national level. We identify four types of factors-Eurozone-wide, country, sectoral, and regionaland focus on the impact of the introduction of the euro. Our results show that, prior to the euro, regional factors were the main drivers of BC fluctuations, whereas after the euro's introduction, sectoral factors became more prominent, indicating increased synchronization driven by horizontal integration. We then estimate a structural VAR model to uncover the sources of these factors. The findings reveal that, post-euro, monetary policy shocks have become the dominant source of BC synchronization in the Eurozone, while sectoral transmission has shifted toward external price and demand channels, especially in tradable sectors. Nevertheless, persistent fiscal and real-side heterogeneity across member states continues to shape asymmetric adjustment. These results highlight the growing role of common monetary and sectoral forces but also underscore the need for policies that address intra-national disparities in future integration efforts.

AI.tldr: 使用贝叶斯动态潜因子模型分析欧元区1980-2019年商业周期同步性，发现欧元引入后从区域驱动转向行业驱动，货币政策冲击成为主要同步来源，但成员国间财政和实际面异质性持续存在。
AI.research_question: 欧元引入如何影响欧元区商业周期同步性的驱动因素和来源？
AI.motivation: 理解欧元区经济一体化进程中商业周期同步性的演变机制，特别是欧元引入对区域、行业和国家层面同步性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 商业周期同步理论，经济一体化理论，货币联盟理论，区域经济学理论
AI.method: 使用51个NUTS 1区域、6个行业、9个欧元区国家1980-2019年数据，采用贝叶斯动态潜因子模型识别四类因子（欧元区整体、国家、行业、区域），并运用结构VAR模型分析因子来源。
AI.findings: 1. 欧元引入前：区域因子是商业周期波动主要驱动力；2. 欧元引入后：行业因子变得更重要，表明水平整合驱动的同步性增强；3. 货币政策冲击成为欧元区商业周期同步的主要来源；4. 行业传导转向外部价格和需求渠道（特别是可贸易部门）；5. 成员国间财政和实际面异质性持续导致不对称调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出多层次商业周期同步分析框架；2. 揭示欧元引入对同步性驱动机制的转变；3. 识别货币政策在货币联盟中的主导作用；4. 阐明行业传导渠道的变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为欧元区政策制定提供实证依据；2. 强调需要针对成员国内部差异的政策；3. 指出未来一体化应关注行业和货币政策协调；4. 为其他货币联盟提供参考。

detail.abstract: This Appendix contains additional results for Hyman et al., Choosing a Nursing Home: How Useful Are CMS Star Ratings? (working paper 2026), including additional tables and figures for our national study of the relationship between nursing home star ratings and various input factors (citations and penalties), and more detailed results from four large states: California, Florida, New York, and Texas.

AI.tldr: 该附录提供了Hyman等人关于养老院CMS星级评级的补充结果，包括全国研究中评级与输入因素关系的额外表格和图表，以及加州、佛罗里达、纽约和德克萨斯四个大州的详细分析。
AI.research_question: CMS星级评级在多大程度上反映了养老院的实际质量？这些评级与监管机构的处罚、投诉等输入因素之间的关系如何？
AI.motivation: CMS星级评级系统是消费者选择养老院的重要参考工具，但现有研究对其有效性和准确性存在争议。了解这些评级与实际质量指标之间的关系对于改进评级系统、帮助消费者做出明智选择至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管有效性理论、质量测量理论、信息不对称理论、消费者决策理论
AI.method: 定量分析：使用全国养老院数据，分析CMS星级评级与各种输入因素（如监管机构的处罚、投诉记录等）之间的统计关系；特别对四个大州（加州、佛罗里达、纽约、德克萨斯）进行详细案例分析

title: How Managers Influence Politics: The Consequences of Increasing CEO Pay for British Party Donations
affiliations: NORCE Norwegian Research Centre AS and University of Erfurt - Willy Brandt School of Public Policy

detail.title: How Managers Influence Politics: The Consequences of Increasing CEO Pay for British Party Donations
detail.abstract: Top executive compensation is rising across Europe. What are the political consequences of this trend? We derive three theoretical expectations linking the political donations of CEOs to executive compensation: ideology, performance, and policy. Empirically, we use an original dataset of British top executives, their pay, and their party donations for the period 2001 to 2015, covering four parliamentary elections. We run a battery of tests to see how responsive donations were to CEO pay. We find that there is indeed some responsivity, but that it is not equal across all parties in the UK. While the level of party donations by top managers supporting the Conservatives is much higher, the pay elasticity of donations is much higher for donations to the Labour Party. In other words, donations to Labour rise with CEO pay, while they remain roughly stable for donations to Conservatives. There is also evidence that this elasticity is greater for specific types of remuneration (equity) and for specific sectors (finance). We conclude that there are indications that New Labour adopting more moderate policy stances also led to more (albeit limited) support from the business elite. This has major implications for party competition and democracies in an age of heightened income inequality.

AI.tldr: 英国高管薪酬上升影响政治捐款：保守党捐款总额高但弹性低，工党捐款总额低但随薪酬增长弹性高，尤其受股权薪酬和金融行业影响，反映新工党温和政策获得有限商业精英支持

title: Precision Agriculture Impact on Agriculture Production in the Rural Society of the World

detail.title: Precision Agriculture Impact on Agriculture Production in the Rural Society of the World

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The article was wrote for the purpose of food production in the world
declarations.ethicsApproval: Articles were downloaded from the net and the similarity index is only 5%
declarations.funderStatement: No fund was provided by any agency

detail.abstract: Precision agriculture are the techniques through which the greenhouses gases are reduced and kept the environment clean for future generation while production of agriculture is improved for present population as well as for future generation. Fertilizer and pesticides cost, hazard effects on environment are reduced AI, IOT, drone, reboots and GPS technologies are used for controlling the disease, pest, deficiencies of the cropping field. The present study was carried out since December, 2025, to investigate the precision agriculture impact on agriculture production in the rural society of the world. The world population day by day increasing which put pressure on the soil and increase per person food load on the world community. Through different sources namely energies, industries, agriculture activities etc. release the green houses gases which create the global warming and change the climate pattern, however it damage the living organisms which affect the food production while it disturb the survival of the living organism of the world. Food is the big issue of the world for survival of life. Similarly the precision agriculture through different technologies namely IOT, AI, Drone, Reboots, solve the problems, for solution of the food crises. Total 27 articles were downloaded from the web of science, net and different sources. All articles were read, again and again to fully analyze the situation, for the food crises solution. The review indicates that precision agriculture application is very important for increasing the production of the world society. Without food the survival of the world is impossible, while the precision agriculture face some problems and constraint. The cost of machinery is very high and it is difficult in developing countries of the world. The study further explain that world Bank and different organization financially supported the developing countries of the world namely Bangladesh, Ghana, Uganda etc. Different projects are working in these countries for increasing the production of agriculture while through precision agriculture environment is kept clean. The IOT, drone, GSP , component analysis, application analysis, technology analysis, farm size analysis, opportunities & threats analysis, regional outlook, competitor outlook, Brandon Bioscience, Bio stimulant technologies are used for the sustainable environment and for high agriculture production in the world,. Similarly data for future analysis are collected to how plan for the present and for the future generation. By precision agriculture farmer will be sit at their home and data about their crops, soil, pest etc. will be observed on their mobiles and the crops and attack will be controlled. Due to huge cost its implementation in the whole world is impossible because the machines are very costly and the purchasing power of the developing countries is limited. Based on financial constraints and problems, the study recommend that to World Bank, IMF and developed countries of the world  provide huge amount to developing countries for precision agriculture implementation to overcome the food crisis  and sustainably in the world; Similarly protect the ecological zone of the world for happening the agriculture activities; Awareness should be given to world community for controlling the situation; Greenhouse gases from different sources in the world should be reduced for enhancing agriculture production; New innovation  technologies should be developed for precision agriculture improvement; Precision agriculture effects on the world survival should be noted on year basis; Industrial , energies and agriculture zone should be evaluated for greenhouse gases discharging; Check the precision agriculture benefits and loss on year basis how much it benefited the community of the world and how much it damage. In the past many programs were held for the benefits of the world communities while instead of benefits it increases the losses of the community.The study concludes that precision agriculture is the only tool to produce the food, according to the world demand and escape the world ecosystem from the pollution to keep fit for future generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文综述了精准农业在解决全球粮食危机和环境保护中的作用，分析了其技术应用（AI、物联网、无人机等）、面临的成本挑战，并建议国际组织为发展中国家提供资金支持以实现可持续农业发展。

AI.motivation: 全球人口增长导致粮食需求增加，传统农业活动产生温室气体加剧气候变化，而精准农业技术能提高产量同时减少环境影响，但发展中国家面临成本障碍。
